jobs.title: Sertisseur (H/F)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR122752 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. VOTRE MISSION : Presser et fixer des diamants et autres pierres précieuses sur des bijoux, des objets, des composants de montres ou des lunettes, conformément aux exigences de qualité, de délai et de sécurité. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Sur la production : Réaliser des opérations de sertissage sur les composants horlogers et joaillers Utiliser des techniques manuelles de sertissage : grain, traditionnel, baguette, clos, griffe, invisible S’assurer de la conformité et de la qualité des pièces livrées Sur les nouveautés : Travailler sur des petites séries Participer à l’industrialisation des nouveaux produits Sur l’atelier : Travailler en équipe avec les autres métiers artisans de l’atelier Être force de proposition d’amélioration LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Expérience dans le domaine du sertissage indispensable, idéalement dans un milieu horloger, avec de préférence entre 3-5 ans de pratique, Une formation en bijouterie, est un plus. Vous êtes passionné et vous faites preuve d’exigence, de minutie et de précision dans votre travail. Vous aimez travailler en équipe et avez de bonnes capacités de communication. Vous êtes ouvert à la participation d’évènements pour la présentation du métier. jobs.title: DWP Unified Communications - Messaging Intern

titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire en Communications Unifiées - Messagerie DWP

jobs.description: Reference code: JR122028 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Nowadays Unified Communications through online meetings, chats, calls and email technologies are providing core solutions to employees aiming to communicate seamlessly and securely in a strong digital era. Join the team that strives to provide cutting edge and ubiquitous communication solutions.” - Andre Tshinkenke, Unified Communications Tech Team Lead CONTEXT We are looking for an intern to assist the Richemont Unified Communications team in helping to automate processes throughout our group email platform across Brands and Regions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a DWP-UC Intern, you will help to automate processes to automate processes and tasks to improve management our email platform ecosystem (Microsoft Exchange and Email Signature Solution, Proofpoint Email gateway): Integration of Microsoft Exchange and our new acquired email signature solution. Review and adapt scripts and automation process around various email related products. Build Data Analytics dashboards that reflects usage of various UC products. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You are an excellent communicator and are rigorous and able to anticipate needs with a strong sense of initiative, and a good team spirit. You are client oriented, open-minded and organized and love to be challenged to solve problems. You have developer skills with a focus on c#, .net and Powershell scripting. You are fluent in English, French is a plus. Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory Available for a 6-month internship with starting date ASAP HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? By providing you great opportunities to become a part of a dynamic and diverse environment where passion is not scarce and where you can count on your team to go that extra mile with you to reach success. This position will also be your opportunity to deepen your knowledge of how a platform for 50000 user mailboxes is managed while thinking the future with the people in the center. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory interview. The next step from there would be a first HR interview and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with the hiring manager. You will be proposed a Behavioral Assessment to see how well you match with the team. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Test Management Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Knowledge Management Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Product Development Product Owner Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Responsable Maintenance
jobs.description: Reference code: JR123743 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont, l’un des leaders mondiaux dans le secteur du luxe, possède différentes Maisons spécialisées dans la joaillerie, l’horlogerie et les accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison incarne fièrement une tradition de style, de qualité et d’artisanat et Richemont s’efforce de préserver l’héritage et l’identité propres à chacune d’elle. Dans le même temps, nous nous engageons à innover et à concevoir de nouveaux produits en accord avec les valeurs de nos Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité permanente. Les Ateliers de la Métallurgie Suisse est une entreprise qui détient la patente d’Essayeur-fondeur et qui approvisionne les marchés horlogers et joaillers en produits semi-finis. NOUS RECHERCHONS Intégré(e) au sein de la Direction Technique sur le site de Varinor à Delémont, vous assurerez le management des secteurs maintenance bâtiment, maintenance machines et conciergerie. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Définir la politique de maintenance Gérer le budget maintenance Proposer des actions d’amélioration et de réduction des coûts Participer à la politique des investissements industriels bâtiment et machines Superviser la maintenance des installations de production et des bâtiments Manager les différents services de maintenance / conciergerie Développer la GMAO et exploiter toutes ses capacités Assurer le bon déroulement des actions techniques liées à la production, sécurité, environnement et conditions de travail Négocier et établir les contrats de prestations de services liés à la maintenance et en assurer le suivi Coordonner la mise en place et le suivi des projets LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Issu(e) d’une formation supérieure en maintenance industrielle, vous disposez impérativement d’une expérience confirmée dans un poste similaire. Expert(e) reconnu(e) dans différentes techniques (électricité, mécanique, hydraulique, pneumatique…), vous maîtrisez parfaitement la GMAO (pilotage et développement) ainsi que Microsoft office et idéalement SAP. Proactif(ve), rigoureux(se) et flexible, vous êtes orienté(e) résultats. Votre sens des responsabilités, de l’organisation et du service seront autant d’atouts pour mener à bien vos missions. CATEGORIE DE CONTRAT Contrat à durée indéterminée LIEU DE TRAVAIL Suisse - Glovelier Les collaborateurs du Groupe forment une grande famille. Ainsi, nous nous engageons à leur fournir un environnement de travail équitable, ouvert et basé sur la confiance. Il est important pour nous de veiller à ce que tous les nouveaux collaborateurs soient fortement engagés dans les valeurs que nous partageons. Dans cet esprit, nous nous réservons le droit de demander à tous les candidats ayant atteint les dernières étapes de la sélection de faire l'objet d'une procédure de vérification préalable à toute embauche. Notre procédure de vérification préalable à l'embauche repose sur les principes de transparence et de respect mutuel, préserve le droit de chaque individu et respecte la législation en vigueur. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Responsable de Ligne Produit F/H Save Le Brassus, Switzerland Vacheron Constantin Spécialiste Analyses Matériaux Save Glovelier, Switzerland Richemont Campus Operations Supervisor Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Spécialiste métier Polissage
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR123848 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. 
• Vos missions principales : En tant que spécialiste métier polissage, vous serez un pilier essentiel de notre atelier de production. 
• Vos responsabilités s'articuleront autour de deux axes majeurs : Apporter une expertise technique pointue et un soutien opérationnel direct à nos équipes de production. Participer activement à l'organisation du travail pour garantir l'optimisation de la qualité, des quantités produites, et l'efficacité des flux au sein de l'atelier. 
• Vos responsabilités au quotidien : Expertise Technique et Formation Participer activement à la production et garantir les bonnes pratiques techniques. Apporter un soutien technique quotidien aux collaborateurs et veiller à l'application des instructions de poste. Identifier les besoins en formation technique, former les équipes et proposer des améliorations continues aux processus. Réaliser des analyses de défauts et évaluer/valider les outillages nécessaires. Optimisation de l'Organisation et de la Performance Contribuer à l'ordonnancement et à l'organisation du travail (distribution, planning) en collaboration avec le responsable d’atelier. Assurer le suivi rigoureux des plannings, des délais et des quantités produites. Participer à la répartition des collaborateurs et de la charge de travail, ainsi qu'au suivi des indicateurs de performance (rendements, rebuts). Garantie de la Qualité Résoudre les problèmes techniques et les non-conformités qualité directement sur le terrain. Participer activement aux démarches d'amélioration continue (5R/5S) et réaliser des audits qualité. Contribuer à l'amélioration des flux en lien avec les autres départements. Soutien au Management Relayer les informations techniques clés et favoriser un climat de travail positif et motivant. Contribuer à l'évaluation de la polyvalence technique des équipes et encadrer les apprentis ou candidats en essai. Être force de proposition sur les aspects techniques, organisationnels et d'amélioration de la performance. 
• Votre profil : Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation technique pertinente ou justifiez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement de production similaire. Vous faites preuve d'un excellent sens de l'organisation et savez gérer les priorités avec efficacité. 
• Vos compétences en communication sont avérées, vous permettant d'interagir avec aisance à tous les niveaux. Vous possédez une très bonne gestion du stress et savez maintenir une attitude positive et motivante. Vous avez un bon esprit d'initiative et êtes force de proposition. Vous maîtrisez les connaissances informatiques de base. #Richemont #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Spécialiste Métier Usinage (Polissage mécanisé) Save Les Breuleux, Switzerland Donzé Baume Référent Programmation Save Les Breuleux, Switzerland Donzé Baume Technicien Méthodes Qualité Save Les Breuleux, Switzerland Donzé Baume

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Reference code: JR124577 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. As a Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end development of software solutions that connect our AI and Data Engineering capabilities with tangible business value. You’ll design scalable backend infrastructure, create functional user interfaces, and ensure secure, compliant application delivery across the organization. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? "The software engineer sits at the vital link between data capabilities and business value, ensuring that every machine learning model and data insight is operationalized into a robust, scalable, and usable application." Navigating between technical infrastructure and business needs, you will have the opportunity to design the tools and applications that drive business efficiency across the Maison. YOUR MAIN MISSIONS Within the Cartier Data Office, you will build business-ready applications, high-performance microservices, and functional internal tools. End-to-End Application Delivery: You will design and develop complete software solutions, handling both server-side logic (Python, FastAPI) and client-side interfaces (HTML, CSS, JS). API & Microservices Architecture: You will build and maintain microservices and REST APIs to expose data and ML capabilities, ensuring seamless integration within the wider ecosystem. Organizational Collaboration: You will bridge the gap between tech and business, collaborating effectively with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to operationalize machine learning models and data pipelines into production workflows. Platform Operations & DevOps: You will maintain robust deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Git) and infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform ensuring reliability and long-term maintainability. Compliance & Governance: You will ensure all software adheres to group standards, security protocols, and evolving AI regulations, proactively adapting to changing governance models. Operational Excellence: You will drive engineering efficiency by creating standardized project templates and reusable libraries to significantly accelerate Time-To-Market. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You have a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related scientific field and 3-5 years of experience in full-stack or backend development. You have strong proficiency in Python and backend frameworks (e.g., FastAPI), along with knowledge of standard frontend web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). You have a deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, GKE) and modern deployment workflows (CI/CD, Containerization). You possess the ability to operate effectively within large, matrixed organizations, managing diverse stakeholders and legacy systems. You are agile and able to align with rapidly evolving internal standards, procedures, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., AI governance). You can act as a translator, streamlining the connection between the tech and the business to ensure seamless integration of our solutions within the wider ecosystem. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a young and dynamic team focused on personal development, you will take part in Cartier’s tech journey, leveraging state-of-the-art tools. You will work with multicultural stakeholders from different business units for a leading Company in the luxury industry. You will have the opportunity to mentor team members as our engineering maturity grows. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Introductory Call: If selected, we will reach out ASAP for an informal introductory call. Technical Interview: A deep dive into your Python, System Design, and software engineering skills with our Team Lead. jobs.title: Logistics Manufacturing Tech Team Lead
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR124697 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Logistic Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Logistic Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Logistic such as Inbound/Outbound process, inventory management, production integration. This scope is covered by SAP EWM used as a back-End Warehouse Management System, which is exposed to various Logistic Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Logistic as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & WMS from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP ERP & EWM, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first Technical interview with the Manufacturing Product Area Manager and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with him/her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Production & Maintenance Quality Assurance Engineer Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Product Development Product Owner Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Tech Team Lead Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Logistic Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Logistic Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Logistic such as Inbound/Outbound process, inventory management, production integration. This scope is covered by SAP EWM used as a back-End Warehouse Management System, which is exposed to various Logistic Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Logistic as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & WMS from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP ERP & EWM, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. jobs.title: Stagiaire Archiviste
jobs.description: Reference code: JR126627 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. Le/La stagiaire archiviste aura pour mission de soutenir l’équipe des archives dans la gestion, la conservation et la valorisation des fonds documentaires du Groupe. Il/Elle participera activement aux projets en cours visant à organiser et rendre accessibles les informations historiques et contemporaines, qu’elles soient physiques ou numériques. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Traitement des fonds : Réaliser l’inventaire, le classement et la description de documents physiques et numériques. Participer à la saisie et à la mise à jour des données dans les bases de données archivistiques. Numérisation : Assister dans les projets de numérisation des collections, y compris la préparation des documents, la numérisation elle-même et le contrôle qualité des images. Participer à l’indexation et à la description des documents numérisés. Recherche et communication : Apporter un soutien aux recherches documentaires internes. Contribuer à la valorisation des fonds (expositions, publications, internes, etc.) si l’opportunité se présente. Gestion quotidienne : Participer aux tâches administratives courantes du service des archives. LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Vous recherchez un stage dans le cadre de vos études (Master) en Archiviste, Sciences de l'information Vous maîtrisez les outils du Pack office et êtes familier avec les logiciels archivistiques et avez une sensibilité aux enjeux de la numérisation de la conservation numérique Vous portez un grand intérêt pour l'horlogerie Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre méthode et votre sens de l'organisation Vous êtes autonome, proactif et avez un esprit analytique. Vous êtes doté d'un bon esprit d'équipe et un très bon relationnel Vous maîtrisez le français (anglais professionnel serait un atout). POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Vous êtes notre meilleur atout. En rejoignant Jaeger-LeCoultre, tout un monde d'opportunités s'ouvre à vous ! La transmission du savoir est l'âme même de notre métier : vous aurez accès à un programme de formation sur mesure. Dans nos bureaux Suisses, nous répondons à votre désir de bien-être et d'équilibre, grâce à un lieu de travail stimulant, du travail à distance, des horaires flexibles, une contribution à la mobilité durable, des services sur site et du temps pour le bénévolat. Notre Maison travaille sans relâche pour gérer son empreinte environnementale et créer un impact positif sur la société grâce à nos efforts collectifs. Apprenez-en davantage sur nos engagements en termes de Développement Durable dans notre programme « Rendre notre Monde Meilleur ». jobs.title: Spécialiste métier Usinage
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR126311 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. En tant que Spécialiste Métier Usinage, vous serez le référent technique dans ce domaine au sein de notre atelier Ebauches. Grâce à votre expertise, vous garantirez la maîtrise et l’optimisation des procédés d’usinage, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais. Véritable soutien du Responsable secteur, vous interviendrez directement sur la production et contribuerez à l’amélioration continue des processus, tout en veillant à un bon climat de travail et à l’accompagnement de l’équipe. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Expertise technique et suivi des procédés Être le référent technique en usinage sur l’ensemble du parc machine (tournage, fraisage 3axes) Définir, valider et optimiser les paramètres d’usinage Réaliser et/ou valider les réglages machines pour garantir la conformité et la répétabilité Assurer un niveau de qualité optimal en respectant les standards internes Assurer la préparation et l’entretien des machines et des équipements associés Gestion des priorités et amélioration continue Identifier et résoudre les défauts d’usinage Mettre en place et suivre des actions correctives durables en collaboration avec la production, les méthodes et la qualité Contribuer à l’optimisation des procédés existants Participer à l’industrialisation des nouveaux produits Assurer le respect des délais et la gestion des priorités en lien avec l’ordonnancement Développement des équipes et respect des normes Former et accompagner les collaborateurs pour garantir une montée en compétences y compris les apprentis. Expliquer et faire appliquer les instructions de poste et standards internes. jobs.title: Constructeur Mouvement H/F
jobs.description: Reference code: JR125044 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Correspondez vous au profil ? Vous disposez d’une expérience en construction de mouvements horlogers. Votre esprit méthodique, votre curiosité et votre créativité vous permettent de mener à bien des projets innovants en lien avec l’identité de la Maison. Vous maîtrisez la micromécanique (ou un domaine équivalent en mécanique de précision ou technologie horlogère) ainsi qu'un logiciel de CAO. Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Rattaché(e) au Directeur Recherche & Développement Horlogerie, le Constructeur Mouvement (H/F) développe des mouvements ou mécanismes ainsi que les dossiers techniques associés, à destination de l'horlogerie et à la Mécanique d'Art de la Maison. Les développements sont menés en lien avec l'ensemble des acteurs concernés des Ateliers Horlogers (Meyrin & Ste Croix), du département Objet Extraordinaires à Paris, des partenaires externes. Dans le cadre de vos missions vous serez en charge de : Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers, de la phase de concept à la production. Réaliser des études de faisabilité et des analyses techniques. Élaborer des plans de construction détaillés et des nomenclatures. Effectuer des simulations et des tests pour valider les performances et la fiabilité des mouvements. Collaborer avec le studio de design, le bureau d'habillage (boîtier) et les autres constructeurs (boîtier, cadran et mouvement) pour assurer la mise en œuvre des nouveaux mouvements. Suivre l'évolution des technologies et des matériaux dans le domaine de l'horlogerie. Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de conception. Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière ! Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition. Dès votre intégration, vous serez immergé(e) dans l’univers de la Maison grâce à des formations sur notre histoire, notre savoir-faire et notre culture. Le processus de recrutement Postulez directement en ligne. Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l'équipe RH pour un entretien. Vous rencontrerez le Directeur Recherche & Développement Horlogerie, puis la Responsable des Ressources Humaines. jobs.title: Bijoutier (H/F)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR127117 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. VOTRE MISSION : Au sein de notre Direction Manufacturing et rattaché au département Boîtes, vous serez en charge de conduire, coordonner et contrôler l’atelier des Boîtes Complications afin de respecter les programmes et leur réalisation dans les conditions de quantité, qualité, coût, délai et sécurité prévus. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? Finition et Polissage des Boîtes de Montres : Réaliser toutes les opérations de finition (polissage, satinage, brossage, etc.) sur les boîtes et composants de montres, en utilisant des machines spécifiques et en assurant la conformité aux spécifications techniques et esthétiques. Préparation et Assemblage : Préparer les boîtes pour les étapes ultérieures (galvanoplastie, sertissage) et assembler leurs différents éléments (carrure, lunette, fond, glace, joints) en respectant les tolérances et les procédures d'étanchéité, puis contrôler leur ajustement et fonctionnement. Compétences Spécifiques en Bijouterie : Préparer les boîtes pour le sertissage, effectuer la finition de pièces joaillières (y compris les ajustements ou petites réparations) et maîtriser les spécificités des métaux précieux (or, platine). Contrôle Qualité : Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels rigoureux à chaque étape, identifier et signaler les non-conformités, et assurer la traçabilité des pièces et des opérations. LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Formation et Expérience : CFC Bijoutier ou CFC Termineur Habillage Horloger, complété idéalement par un diplôme ou une expérience significative. Minimum entre 5 et 10 ans d'expérience en bijouterie (préparation au sertissage, finition de pièces joaillières) et en terminaison horlogère (produits hauts de gamme). Compétences Techniques : Maîtrise des techniques de finition horlogère (polissage, satinage, brossage) et des machines associées. Excellente dextérité, acuité visuelle, connaissance des métaux (acier, or, platine, titane) et capacité à lire des plans techniques. Qualités Personnelles : Minutie, précision, rigueur, sens de l'organisation, autonomie et esprit d'équipe. Capacité à gérer la pression et à respecter les délais, avec une passion pour l'horlogerie et la joaillerie de haute qualité. jobs.title: Product Manager - Customer Relations Centers (CRCs)

titleByLocale.it: Product Manager - Centri di relazioni con i clienti (CRC)
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de produits - Centres de relations avec la clientèle (CRCs)

jobs.description: Reference code: JR128112 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: The Product Manager - CRCs will play a pivotal role in defining, developing, and optimizing the digital products and tools that empower Richemont's Customer Relations Centers (CRCs) teams. This senior position is responsible for enhancing the client experience by ensuring our CRC ambassadors have best-in-class technology and streamlined processes to efficiently and effectively manage client inquiries and transactions, primarily over the phone. The role requires a strategic vision for the future of client technology, coupled with a deep understanding of operational processes and a hands-on approach to product delivery. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Product Strategy & Vision: Define and champion the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all applications and platforms utilized by Richemont's CRCs, aligning with overall business objectives and client experience goals and omni-channel needs. Leadership & Oversight: Act as a leader, overseeing and guiding product teams responsible for the development and continuous improvement of CRC-facing products. Provide mentorship and strategic direction to ensure consistent product excellence. Stakeholder Management: Collaborate extensively with CRC operations, Group Technology and Maisons responsible teams. Manage as well external vendors to gather requirements, orchestrate expectations, and ensure product solutions meet diverse business needs. Product Lifecycle mindset: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery, ideation, and requirements gathering to development, launch, adoption, and post-launch optimization. Roadmap & Backlog Management: Develop and maintain a clear, prioritized product roadmap and backlog, ensuring features deliver maximum business value, enhance agent efficiency, and improve the overall client journey. Technology Expertise: Drive the strategic adoption and optimization of key technologies within the CRC ecosystem, with a strong focus on Salesforce (particularly Service Cloud) and integrated telephony solutions. Process Optimization: Champion a business profile rooted in process excellence, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and improve operational efficiency through technological solutions. Performance Analysis: Define key performance indicators (KPIs), monitor product performance, analyse user feedback, and leverage data insights to inform product decisions and drive continuous improvement. Compliance & Security: Ensure all product developments adhere to Richemont's data privacy, security, and compliance standards. Market & Trend Analysis: Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor activities in the contact center space to identify innovative opportunities. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree or relevant certifications (e.g., CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are a plus. Skills and Experience: Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in Product Management or Senior Product Ownership roles, with a significant focus on customer service, contact center, or client relations technologies. Certifications in the space are considered a plus. Demonstrated expertise in managing products related to Salesforce (e.g., Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud) and integrated telephony platforms (e.g., Genesys, Vonage, AWS, Twilio, Avaya). Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of operational processes within a customer service environment, particularly for phone-based client inquiries. Proven ability to define and drive product strategy, translating complex business needs into clear product requirements and user stories. Strong experience leading and inspiring cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and engage effectively at all levels of the organization. Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, execution, and continuous improvement. Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to inform decisions and measure impact. jobs.title: Procurement Process Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128179 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make. Our key initiatives include: Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our Procure to Pay processes, enhancing efficiency optimization and user experience. Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities. Digitalizing end-to-end procurement About the Role: As a Procurement Process Manager in Richemont's Group Procurement Excellence team, you'll drive operational efficiency and digital transformation of our global end to end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. You will own the end-to-end design, optimization, and governance of P2P workflows, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and a seamless user experience across the Group. You will drive complex P2P process and system transformations, from strategic analysis and design to implementation and continuous improvement. This involves collaborating with executive stakeholders, cross-functional teams (IT, Finance, Legal, Maisons), and external partners, leveraging technology, and aligning with Group Procurement and Finance strategies. We seek a visionary expert with deep P2P process knowledge, strategic thinking, and a proven ability to drive large-scale change. You will architect user-centric solutions, use advanced data analytics, and implement sophisticated process optimization to deliver measurable improvements, acting as the primary P2P process design expert This is a key opportunity to lead critical P2P transformation initiatives at Richemont, making a profound impact on our operational backbone within a leading luxury goods group. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT? Drive Process Optimization: Analyze existing Non-Stock Goods and Services procurement processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement data-driven solutions to enhance speed, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness while ensuring adherence to internal controls, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Drive automation and AI use cases to streamline processes. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI, agentic, orchestration …) Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary P2P process expert, partnering with and influencing senior leadership across IT, Finance, Legal, and Maisons to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, and ensure strategic alignment. Champion Change Management: Lead comprehensive change management for major P2P transformations. Develop and deliver executive communications, training, and support to ensure successful adoption and sustained behavioral change.. Develop and Maintain Process Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive process documentation, including policies, flowcharts, procedures, and training materials. Enhance User Experience: Design and implement user-friendly solutions that improve the overall experience for all stakeholders involved in the procurement process. Monitor and Report on KPIs: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of implemented improvements and identify areas for further optimization. Regularly report on progress and impact to stakeholders. Continually assess pain points and prioritize uplift and simplification of procurement frameworks to enable operational teams to focus on strategy execution HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? To be successful in this role, you will need: A Master's degree in Procurement, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field. 7-10+ years of extensive experience in process analysis, design, and transformation, with a significant focus on end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes in a large, multinational organization, preferably decentralized. Proven expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing complex global P2P processes, including requisitioning, purchase order management, goods receipt, invoice processing and payment, Demonstrated experience leading major P2P transformation and digitalization projects, including new technology implementations (e.g., orchestration, AI, SAP Ariba, Coupa, …) and process re-engineering. Strong understanding of procurement and finance principles, best practices, internal controls, and compliance. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills, translating complex challenges into actionable P2P solution Superior communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to engage executive-level stakeholders and manage diverse cross-functional teams. Experience with process mining tools (e.g., Celonis) and advanced data analytics for process insights is highly desirable Proficiency in English (mandatory); additional language skills, especially French, are a plus. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group Procurement Data and Analytics Senior Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont Procurement Excellence Intern Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Stage - Assistant(e) Supply Chain Amont
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128428 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Stage Assistant(e) Supply Chain Amont (H/F) Début du stage : Septembre 2026 Durée : 6 mois - temps complet Lieu : Genève, Suisse Correspondez-vous au profil ? Vous êtes étudiant(e) d’un cursus avec une dominante Supply Chain, ingénieur, ou équivalent ? Appréciant le travail d’équipe, vous disposez d’un bon esprit de synthèse et vous êtes à l’aise avec la communication écrite ? Proactif(ve), vous avez le goût de l’intrapreneuriat et de l’autonomie pour développer des processus existants et en créer de nouveaux ? Vous avez une forte capacitée d’analyse, maîtrisez Excel, et idéalement une solution d’analyse de données type Power Bi? Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? Au sein de l’équipe Supply Chain, vous participez à la construction et à l’amélioration des processus Supply Chain sur les composants communs des créations joaillières de la Maison (Pierres Précieuses, Pierres Ornementales, apprêts métaux type chaine, fermoirs, etc..). Vous participez à la formalisation des processus & outils existants de planification des composants communs de la maison, en veillant à comprendre le modèle Supply Chain Amont. Vous avez pour mission de cartographier les différents flux & process afin d’établir une présentation globale du système dans un but pédagogique et de communication. Vous accompagnez le Supply Chain Planner dans l’élaboration des KPI & des procédures nécessaires au pilotage de son activité. Vous participez à la rationalisation des nomenclatures de planification, et des bases de données stratégie sourcing en vue d’une intégration dans Anaplan. Vous vous formez à la planification en assistant le Planificateur Amont dans ses taches de planification du besoin, recommandations de dimensionnement de stocks et de quantités à engager, préparation de supports décisionnaires pour les instances de validation. Afin de faciliter votre intégration, nous vous proposerons une formation à l’histoire et aux valeurs de la Maison. Plus qu’un stage… une expérience ! jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128793 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The Boutique Manager manages and will develop a multicultural team. You will be responsible for achieving our commercial ambitions and providing our customers with unforgettable experiences that reflect the Maison signature, while ensuring the excellence and compliance of boutique operations. An agile and inspiring leader, a true ambassador for the Maison, you will be the driving force behind an emblematic boutique with international resonance, which you will also be responsible for promoting internally as an incubator for our best talents, professions and operating models of tomorrow. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Working in collaboration with the various Cartier Switzerland departments, you will be responsible for the boutique's commercial and operational performance by improving the main retail efficiency indicators, developing the team's skills and optimising operational costs. As an experienced and exemplary manager, you will create a positive and motivating environment that encourages performance, learning and personal development. Managing, training and developing your team gives you a sense of fulfilment and gives everyone the opportunity to contribute to our collective success. Developing your employees’ skills and optimising the organisation of the boutique life in an agile way are key to achieving and surpassing the objectives set. Creative and proactive, you will translate the boutique's strategy and ambitions into individual and collective priorities and objectives on a daily basis. As an ambassador for the boutique and the Maison, you will be an exemplary embodiment of the image and values of the Maison, which you will represent to all its internal and external audiences, both in and out of the boutique. You will be approachable, engaging and professional at all times, and demonstrate an excellent level of self-awareness. Working closely with the sales and communications teams, you will ensure that the customer is constantly at the heart of your actions at all levels of the organisation, in strict compliance with the Maison's image and strategy. Guaranteeing the perfect orchestration of the customer experience, you will bring to bear at the highest level our expertise in terms of hospitality, personalised experiences and event programming. Attentive to the smallest detail, uncompromisingly demanding but agile at all times, you will ensure the quality and enrichment of our database and its strategic and tactical activation in the service of our stated ambition: to engage and surprise our customers of yesterday, today and tomorrow. You will be responsible for ensuring that the customer strategy, the customer action plan and the boutique's annual events programme are fully deployed to enhance its appeal and influence. In compliance with the policies, procedures and directives of our Maison, you will supervise operations and be responsible for promoting a culture of efficiency and continuous improvement at all levels of the organisation. All these actions converge to serve a triple objective: the perfect management of flows, the optimisation of the employee experience and the fluidity of the customer experience. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master's degree or equivalent 10+ years Retail experience in managing and developing large teams Strong leadership, communication and management skills with a flair for business and customers. Knowledge of the luxury goods industry and the jewellery and watchmaking sectors is a plus. Strong organisational skills and long-term vision. Strong expertise in clienteling and handling VIP clients. Performance culture and results orientation. Excellent analytical skills and understanding of retail productivity levers. Experience in an international environment. Fluency in German and English. Strong digital skills and an interest in new technologies and media. Strong interpersonal skills. Willingness to work weekend shifts and travel for training, customer events, etc. as required. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The Boutique Manager manages and will develop a multicultural team. You will be responsible for achieving our commercial ambitions and providing our customers with unforgettable experiences that reflect the Maison signature, while ensuring the excellence and compliance of boutique operations. An agile and inspiring leader, a true ambassador for the Maison, you will be the driving force behind an emblematic boutique with international resonance, which you will also be responsible for promoting internally as an incubator for our best talents, professions and operating models of tomorrow. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Working in collaboration with the various Cartier Switzerland departments, you will be responsible for the boutique's commercial and operational performance by improving the main retail efficiency indicators, developing the team's skills and optimising operational costs. As an experienced and exemplary manager, you will create a positive and motivating environment that encourages performance, learning and personal development. Managing, training and developing your team gives you a sense of fulfilment and gives everyone the opportunity to contribute to our collective success. Developing your employees’ skills and optimising the organisation of the boutique life in an agile way are key to achieving and surpassing the objectives set. Creative and proactive, you will translate the boutique's strategy and ambitions into individual and collective priorities and objectives on a daily basis. As an ambassador for the boutique and the Maison, you will be an exemplary embodiment of the image and values of the Maison, which you will represent to all its internal and external audiences, both in and out of the boutique. You will be approachable, engaging and professional at all times, and demonstrate an excellent level of self-awareness. Working closely with the sales and communications teams, you will ensure that the customer is constantly at the heart of your actions at all levels of the organisation, in strict compliance with the Maison's image and strategy. Guaranteeing the perfect orchestration of the customer experience, you will bring to bear at the highest level our expertise in terms of hospitality, personalised experiences and event programming. Attentive to the smallest detail, uncompromisingly demanding but agile at all times, you will ensure the quality and enrichment of our database and its strategic and tactical activation in the service of our stated ambition: to engage and surprise our customers of yesterday, today and tomorrow. You will be responsible for ensuring that the customer strategy, the customer action plan and the boutique's annual events programme are fully deployed to enhance its appeal and influence. In compliance with the policies, procedures and directives of our Maison, you will supervise operations and be responsible for promoting a culture of efficiency and continuous improvement at all levels of the organisation. All these actions converge to serve a triple objective: the perfect management of flows, the optimisation of the employee experience and the fluidity of the customer experience. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Master's degree or equivalent 10+ years Retail experience in managing and developing large teams Strong leadership, communication and management skills with a flair for business and customers. Knowledge of the luxury goods industry and the jewellery and watchmaking sectors is a plus. Strong organisational skills and long-term vision. Strong expertise in clienteling and handling VIP clients. Performance culture and results orientation. Excellent analytical skills and understanding of retail productivity levers. Experience in an international environment. Fluency in German and English. Strong digital skills and an interest in new technologies and media. Strong interpersonal skills. Willingness to work weekend shifts and travel for training, customer events, etc. as required. jobs.title: mécanicien régleur Frappe
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR128878 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. VOTRE MISSION : Procéder aux réglages du balancier et à sa mise en train, assurer et garantir la production de pièces en termes de qualité, de quantité et de délais pour les différentes lignes de production. 
• Vos missions Réglage des machines En adéquation avec l’ordonnancement, préparer le moyen de production. Réaliser le réglage du balancier. Procéder à la validation des nouveaux outillages. Assurer les réglages et la mise en train avec le contrôle des premiers composants. Maintenance des outils de production Garantir la production et le suivi qualité des pièces produites (contrôles statistiques). Suivre le bon fonctionnement de la machine et participer à sa maintenance préventive. Gérer le bon soin des étampes. Exécuter les opérations de fabrications Atteindre les objectifs de cadence définis. Respecter les critères qualités. Suivre les instructions de postes et méthodologies de travail. Alerter en cas d’anomalie process ou de rebuts excessifs. Etre autonome en fabrication et en réglage sur les métiers concernés. Effectuer les opérations d'autocontrôle sur sa production selon les normes qualité en vigueur. Résolution de problèmes Alerter le spécialiste métier. Etre capable d’apporter les premières étapes d’analyses devant un problème avant d’alerter le responsable (30’ maximum). Participer aux résolutions de problème si demandé. Amélioration continue Animer des réflexions avec les spécialistes techniques. Proposer des améliorations pour optimiser la performance. Travailler et participer à des projets en collaboration avec les partenaires internes. Sécurité & Santé au Travail - Sûreté - Environnement Respecter les règles de son activité et de l’entreprise en termes de sécurité, sûreté et respect de l’environnement. S’impliquer dans la prévention des accidents, la sûreté et le respect de l’environnement. Ne mettre en danger ni ses collègues, ni soi-même par son comportement. COMMENT RÉUSSIREZ-VOUS CHEZ NOUS ? jobs.title: Finance Senior Product Owner
jobs.description: Reference code: JR128927 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Do you enjoy orchestrating evolutions towards operational efficiency and future-ready employee experiences? Are you eager to use the latest technologies and participate in the build of constantly improving solutions? If yes, then apply and join us. A team aiming at accelerating business through technology is waiting for you to step up and have an impact on our Group transformation.” YOUR MISSION: As part of Group Platforms' department, Richemont is looking to further strengthen its dynamic Product Management team structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons' value chain strategy. In this context, we are hiring a Finance Senior Product Owner to strategically lead and transform Finance Products with strong interdependencies across various Product Areas. The focus area will be strategic oversight and continuous enhancement of integrated and performing Finance and Accounting solutions across Richemont entities. The Finance Senior Product Owner will ensure full alignment with Group Finance business priorities, complying with business rules and processes defined by the Business Process Owners (BPOs). The Finance Senior Product Owner plays a pivotal role in supporting and driving the Group Finance strategy by leading the development of valuable products and fostering product transformation. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will lead Product transformation, drive strategic initiatives and foster innovation for the Finance & Accounting Product. This includes strategic topics such as finance simplification, e-invoicing, accounting capabilities, M&A integration, and managing critical interdependencies with other business areas. You will act as the strategic interface between the Group Product Office and the Finance Function, ensuring deep understanding and alignment of strategic objectives for the Product You will build and maintain comprehensive roadmaps You will implement consistent Product ways of working (e.g., ceremonies, demand management, fixed capacity models), fostering a mature and efficient product development culture You will proactively steer risks, issues, and related mitigation plans in close collaboration with the Finance function You will regularly communicate and articulate the strategic evolution and impact of the Finance & Accounting Product, demonstrating their contribution to the overarching business vision, particularly to senior stakeholders. You will strategically partner with relevant stakeholders to proactively discover and understand their needs, translating these into strategic product initiatives and requirements for Finance & Accounting Product You will lead the prioritization of demands in close collaboration with the Group Finance organization (Business Process Owners, Center of Excellence, Working Group), ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and resource capacity. You will oversee the strategic maintenance and refinement of the product backlog, ensuring it reflects evolving business needs, maximizes business value and ROI, and aligns with available capacity. You will lead and guide the technical team working on Finance & Accounting solutions, ensuring the strategic product vision is translated effectively into implementation and delivered with high quality. You will proactively facilitate and manage interdependencies with cross-functional teams across Product Areas, ensuring seamless integration and alignment You will champion change management initiatives, fostering adoption and dissemination of comprehensive product training, support tools, and documentation You will drive continuous product improvement initiatives, leveraging user feedback, benefits realization, adoption rates, and key metrics/KPIs to ensure optimal business outcomes and strategic alignment. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Excellence is a top priority for our teams. In this role you have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in major global strategic initiatives for the Richemont Group and its Maisons. Your passion for moving forward, achieving and leading change will find the perfect context within the team. Innovation is at the heart of what we do, joining us means being exposed to latest trends and technologies. DIMENSIONS 10-15 years’ experience in projects/products management, including multinational and innovative environments, in the operational finance or consulting area. B.Sc. or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a Master’s degree in Business Administration. Experience of SAP Financial solutions. jobs.title: Chargé de projets RH (H/F) - CDM
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129049 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de notre Manufacture Joaillère située au Locle, notre Département des Ressources Humaines joue un rôle stratégique dans l'accompagnement et le développement de nos talents. Dans un contexte de transformation et d'amélioration continue, nous recherchons pour un CDM de 24 mois un/e Chargé/e de Projet RH dynamique et engagé/e pour renforcer nos équipes. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Mission Rattaché/e au département des Ressources Humaines, votre mission principale sera de contribuer activement au pilotage et à la coordination de projets clés visant à optimiser nos processus RH et à enrichir l'expérience de nos collaborateurs. Vous serez un acteur central de notre plan de transformation RH, en particulier sur les initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle et d'amélioration continue de l'environnement de travail au sein de la manufacture. Vos Responsabilités Clés : Participer à la définition, la structuration et la validation des cadrages de projets (objectifs, périmètre, livrables, ressources, planning) en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes. Coordonner les différentes phases de déploiement des projets, de la conception à la mise en œuvre, en assurant le respect des délais et des budgets. Mettre en place et animer les instances de suivi de projet, produire des reportings réguliers et clairs à destination de la Direction RH et des comités de pilotage. Identifier les risques et les opportunités, proposer des plans d'action et des solutions innovantes pour garantir le succès des projets. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodologies de gestion de projet au sein du département RH. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Titulaire d'un diplôme supérieur (Bac+4/5) en Ressources Humaines, Gestion de Projet, ou équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience en gestion de projet RH acquise dans un environnement industriel ou de manufacture. Cette expérience vous a permis de développer une solide connaissance des enjeux d'excellence opérationnelle et d'expérience collaborateur. Vous maîtrisez les méthodologies de gestion de projet et possédez une excellente connaissance des processus RH. Vous êtes également à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques (Pack Office, notamment Excel et PowerPoint). Doté/e d'un sens aigu de l'organisation, de rigueur et d'autonomie, vous faites preuve d'excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale, ainsi que d'un sens de la diplomatie. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à fédérer différents acteurs, combinée à votre proactivité, votre force de proposition et votre orientation résultats, sont des atouts essentiels. Enfin, votre esprit d'équipe et votre aisance relationnelle vous permettront de vous intégrer harmonieusement et de collaborer efficacement. VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison. Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez l’un de nos Recruteurs, un membre de notre équipe RH, le/la Responsable du poste et passerez des cas d’étude ou d’évaluation en fonction des besoins du poste. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de notre Manufacture Joaillère située au Locle, notre Département des Ressources Humaines joue un rôle stratégique dans l'accompagnement et le développement de nos talents. Dans un contexte de transformation et d'amélioration continue, nous recherchons pour un CDM de 24 mois un/e Chargé/e de Projet RH dynamique et engagé/e pour renforcer nos équipes. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Mission Rattaché/e au département des Ressources Humaines, votre mission principale sera de contribuer activement au pilotage et à la coordination de projets clés visant à optimiser nos processus RH et à enrichir l'expérience de nos collaborateurs. Vous serez un acteur central de notre plan de transformation RH, en particulier sur les initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle et d'amélioration continue de l'environnement de travail au sein de la manufacture. Vos Responsabilités Clés : Participer à la définition, la structuration et la validation des cadrages de projets (objectifs, périmètre, livrables, ressources, planning) en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes. Coordonner les différentes phases de déploiement des projets, de la conception à la mise en œuvre, en assurant le respect des délais et des budgets. Mettre en place et animer les instances de suivi de projet, produire des reportings réguliers et clairs à destination de la Direction RH et des comités de pilotage. Identifier les risques et les opportunités, proposer des plans d'action et des solutions innovantes pour garantir le succès des projets. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodologies de gestion de projet au sein du département RH. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Cette expérience vous a permis de développer une solide connaissance des enjeux d'excellence opérationnelle et d'expérience collaborateur. Vous maîtrisez les méthodologies de gestion de projet et possédez une excellente connaissance des processus RH. Vous êtes également à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques (Pack Office, notamment Excel et PowerPoint). Doté/e d'un sens aigu de l'organisation, de rigueur et d'autonomie, vous faites preuve d'excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale, ainsi que d'un sens de la diplomatie. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à fédérer différents acteurs, combinée à votre proactivité, votre force de proposition et votre orientation résultats, sont des atouts essentiels. Enfin, votre esprit d'équipe et votre aisance relationnelle vous permettront de vous intégrer harmonieusement et de collaborer efficacement. Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez l’un de nos Recruteurs, un membre de notre équipe RH, le/la Responsable du poste et passerez des cas d’étude ou d’évaluation en fonction des besoins du poste. jobs.title: Procurement Excellence Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129217 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make. Our key initiatives include: Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our P2P Project, ensuring seamless and efficient processes. Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities. Digitalizing end-to-end procurement with our eSHOP platform. You will have the opportunity to make a real difference by contributing to the future of procurement, gain valuable experience in data and process management, and discover the world of luxury by working within a leading luxury group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? This is a unique opportunity to explore the worlds of data and process within our dynamic Procurement Excellence team. As Procurement Excellence Intern, you will: Work closely with Procurement and Technology experts to build the future of digital Procurement at Richemont, contributing to a valuable experience. Contribute to the implementation of digital applications. You will participate in tool selection, design, testing, training and communication. Promote the use of our dashboards and data visualization tools, helping to communicate insights and drive informed decision-making. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You're currently pursuing a Master's degree in Commerce or Engineering. You're analytical and enjoy finding innovative solutions to technical and business challenges. You are a technology enthusiast and are curious about the world of data and digital tools. You can collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating strong communication skills throughout. You thrive in dynamic environments, adapting your skills across diverse business and technical landscapes. You're proficient in English. Proficiency in French is appreciated. You’re ready to join our team starting September 2026. You have an internship agreement with your school/university WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory interview. 2. The next step from there would be a second interview with the Procurement Data Project Manager. 3. As a final step, you will have a last interview with the Procurement Senior Process Manager. At the end, hopefully, we can deliver some good news and greet you as our new colleague! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Piaget Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont
