jobs.title: Group Technology Junior Financial Controller

titleByLocale.it: Junior Controllore Finanziario Tecnologie di Gruppo

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132169 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND Embark on a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the financial landscape of our Group Platforms department. In this transversal role, you will drive essential financial activities, primarily focusing on cost controlling, financial planning, and internal allocation model management. To succeed in this role, you should have a demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. 
• Your responsibilities will be dynamically split, with 70% dedicated to hands-on controlling tasks, working closely with managers to ensure financial rigor, and 30% focused on providing essential support to the wider controlling team, particularly in enhancing data quality and streamlining administrative functions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of Group Finance and based in Meyrin, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Drive Financial Performance & Control Oversee day-to-day financial operations for our technology domains and cost centers, ensuring efficient and appropriate financial control systems. Actively contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, including preparing accruals, reviewing commitments, and assisting with allocation cycles. Partner closely with Group Technology Managers to foster cost awareness and enhance understanding of financial performance, providing insightful analysis and ad-hoc reports. Support the tracking and monitoring of resources for key technology projects and initiatives. Master Planning & Forecasting Play a key role in the planning and forecasting cycles (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), from data collection and analysis to presentation and report preparation. Assist in the review and consolidation of budget components (Investments, Operating expenses, Headcounts) for supported areas. Prepare preliminary management reports and conduct initial variance analysis against financial targets. Ensure Financial Integrity & Compliance Support the Capital Approval Request (CAR) process and contribute to the follow-up of financial commitments, including budget assumption validation and vendor contract checks. Assist in the control and validation of Purchase Orders (PO) in close collaboration with the P2P team. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of cost allocation models, ensuring accurate evaluation of internal and business services. Support the application of Richemont's internal controlling procedures, identifying and addressing potential gaps. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Conduct regular and thorough checks on financial data quality within systems, particularly for time allocation entries and master data accuracy. Identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data integrity issues. Assist in collecting, validating, and consolidating financial data from various sources for reporting and analysis. Contribute to identifying and implementing process improvements within the controlling function, focusing on automation and efficiency. Provide support for ad-hoc financial analysis, data extraction, and special projects as required. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong team spirit and communication skills with aptitude to collaborate transversally across various teams, organizations, and stakeholders. Curious to learn, develop, and contribute to challenging the status-quo. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to pay close attention to detail. Good organizational abilities with proactivity, and keen to work independently while managing ambiguity with guidance when necessary. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, and balance multiple priorities. Education, experience and core competencies University graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a finance or controlling role, preferably within a multinational environment. Relevant internships will be considered. Familiarity with SAP FICO, Anaplan and/or BI tools is an asset. Knowledge of coding languages (like Python), AI prompts (Copilot), and/or RPA. Strong proficiency in Excel is required Demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. Fluent in English, French knowledge is a strong asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value curiosity, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, excellence, courage, collaboration, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

To succeed in this role, you should have a demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. 
• Your responsibilities will be dynamically split, with 70% dedicated to hands-on controlling tasks, working closely with managers to ensure financial rigor, and 30% focused on providing essential support to the wider controlling team, particularly in enhancing data quality and streamlining administrative functions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of Group Finance and based in Meyrin, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Drive Financial Performance & Control Oversee day-to-day financial operations for our technology domains and cost centers, ensuring efficient and appropriate financial control systems. Actively contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, including preparing accruals, reviewing commitments, and assisting with allocation cycles. Partner closely with Group Technology Managers to foster cost awareness and enhance understanding of financial performance, providing insightful analysis and ad-hoc reports. Support the tracking and monitoring of resources for key technology projects and initiatives. Master Planning & Forecasting Play a key role in the planning and forecasting cycles (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), from data collection and analysis to presentation and report preparation. Assist in the review and consolidation of budget components (Investments, Operating expenses, Headcounts) for supported areas. Prepare preliminary management reports and conduct initial variance analysis against financial targets. Ensure Financial Integrity & Compliance Support the Capital Approval Request (CAR) process and contribute to the follow-up of financial commitments, including budget assumption validation and vendor contract checks. Assist in the control and validation of Purchase Orders (PO) in close collaboration with the P2P team. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of cost allocation models, ensuring accurate evaluation of internal and business services. Support the application of Richemont's internal controlling procedures, identifying and addressing potential gaps. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Conduct regular and thorough checks on financial data quality within systems, particularly for time allocation entries and master data accuracy. Identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data integrity issues. Assist in collecting, validating, and consolidating financial data from various sources for reporting and analysis. Contribute to identifying and implementing process improvements within the controlling function, focusing on automation and efficiency. Provide support for ad-hoc financial analysis, data extraction, and special projects as required. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong team spirit and communication skills with aptitude to collaborate transversally across various teams, organizations, and stakeholders. Curious to learn, develop, and contribute to challenging the status-quo. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to pay close attention to detail. Good organizational abilities with proactivity, and keen to work independently while managing ambiguity with guidance when necessary. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, and balance multiple priorities. Education, experience and core competencies University graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a finance or controlling role, preferably within a multinational environment. Relevant internships will be considered. Familiarity with SAP FICO, Anaplan and/or BI tools is an asset. Knowledge of coding languages (like Python), AI prompts (Copilot), and/or RPA. Strong proficiency in Excel is required Demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. Fluent in English, French knowledge is a strong asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value curiosity, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, excellence, courage, collaboration, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Client Services Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132230 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Début du stage : Janvier 2027 Durée : 6 mois - temps complet Localisation : Genève – Suisse Correspondez-vous au profil ? Vous avez une expérience dans le commerce/marketing à l’international et un excellent sens de l’organisation ? Vous appréciez le travail d’équipe, vous êtes curieux(se) et proactif(ve) ? Vous avez des compétences en gestion de projet et une sensibilité pour le monde du retail ? Vous avez un véritable intérêt pour le secteur du luxe et le service client ? Vous parlez couramment l’anglais ? Qu'attendons-nous de vous ? Au sein du Département Service Client de la Maison, vous accompagnez le manager Service Clients et les 3 Chefs de Projets dans leurs missions quotidiennes. De la création de contenu au recueil des besoins en passant par l’analyse de données utilisateurs, vous coordonnerez les différentes améliorations avec les équipes Service Client des régions du monde (US, Asie, Europe, Japon, Moyen-Orient) et avec le soutien du chef de projet. Vous renforcerez l’expérience client, via l’amélioration des solutions digitales en collaboration avec les différentes équipes à l’interne (service client, commerciale, digitale) et à l’externe (agence digitale). Vous serez garant de la planification et de l’animation des réunions avec les équipes internes, de la newsletter envoyée de façon trimestrielle afin de faire la promotion de l’équipe Service Client au sein de la Maison. Enfin, vous serez en charge de la promotion des projets auprès de la communauté internationale Service Client Van Cleef & Arpels. Afin de faciliter votre intégration, nous vous proposerons une formation à l’histoire et aux valeurs de la Maison au sein de L’École des Arts Joailliers. Plus qu’un stage… une expérience ! jobs.description: Reference code: JR132208 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT As a Test Manager intern, you will become a key member of our Quality Assurance team, contributing to the harmonisation of testing practices and the exploration and implementation of AI-driven testing solutions across our domain. You will work closely with an existing Test Manager, embedded in a Product team, reporting to a senior member of the QA leadership. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? (Mention 3 quantitative responsibilities) By bringing valuable insights and a quality-focused mindset, you will contribute to the evolution of our testing landscape. Support the harmonisation of testing methodologies: Assist in documenting, standardizing, and promoting best practices for testing within & across various product teams, aiming for improved efficiency and consistency in our ways of working. Contribute to AI for testing initiatives: Participate in the research, exploration, and initial implementation phases of AI-powered testing tools and strategies, helping to identify potential use cases and measure their impact on testing efficiency and coverage. Collaborate with Test Managers embedded in Product Areas: Work alongside embedded Test Managers to understand their specific testing challenges, gather requirements for harmonisation efforts, and support the integration of new testing approaches and tools. Assist in the preparation of test strategies, test plans, and test reports. Help organize and facilitate workshops or training sessions related to new testing tools or methodologies. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? (What skills do they need to succeed) You are doing a master's degree or are recently graduated (Business or Engineering School) with a strong interest in software quality assurance, testing methodologies, and emerging technologies like AI. You can follow a rapid learning curve and show impactful results (be a doer) after a short discovery phase. You can understand transversal topics from IT to Business requirements, with an ability to grasp the big picture of quality assurance within a large organization. You have a quality-orientated mindset, with an eye for detail and can propose improvements in our testing processes and deliverables. You are effective in communication and can work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and other test managers. You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges in a dynamic environment. Eager to master Test Management and Quality Assurance within an IT environment Skilled in Microsoft 360 (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel & Word), know-how of Atlassian Suite is a bonus. Strong proficiency in English and French is a must. You are available for a 6-month internship with a start date in April 2026 You are eligible for an internship agreement. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? (Work environment and culture) At Richemont, we believe in fostering an environment where every team member can thrive and feel valued. As an Intern Test Manager, you will: Be part of a dynamic and supportive team: Enjoy the various personalities of our team, participate in regular team events, and engage in a variety of activities that promote collaboration and camaraderie. Benefit from mentorship and learning: Work closely with experienced professionals who are dedicated to your growth, providing guidance and opportunities to expand your skills in quality assurance and AI for testing. Contribute to meaningful projects: Your work will directly impact the quality and efficiency of our different scope of activities, giving you a sense of purpose and achievement. Enjoy a stimulating and innovative atmosphere: Be at the forefront of exploring new technologies like AI in testing, contributing to the future of quality assurance within a leading luxury group. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132340 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. As part of its strategic development in Switzerland, Buccellati is looking for a Boutique Manager capable to handle the opening and success of the boutique. Your mission: As an Ambassador of the Buccellati Maison, you will be responsible of the development and optimization of the boutique performance and profitability by managing the boutique team, ensuring excellence in boutique operations and in delivering the best client service and experience. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be in charge of the daily operations of the boutique (front and back office) with the aim to communicate the overall brand message in a successful manner to generate business. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining and promoting the Buccellati brand image and identity, following the Company’s directives. You will be accountable for ensuring maximum sales and profitability of the boutique through merchandise, inventory, expense control and human resources management. Your Key 
• Responsibilities: Boutique performance & Sales achievement: Achieve or surpass monthly and yearly sales targets of the boutique; Meet or exceed the KPI’s set by Retail Management; Respect the brand’s discount policy; Establish budget, track sales and expenses. Maintain budget and related costs within established guidelines; Develop and implement the boutique action plan with the commercial department with a focus on business development; Ensure the sales growth; Gain market share; Review competition trends, recommend and initiate changes for maximizing goals and objectives; Management: Set, implement and supervise the Boutique sales strategy; Guarantee the implementation and regular monitoring of the Boutique action plan (Result driven, monthly review and keep update, monitor and follow up the plan); Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures through regular store management and staff meetings, store walk-through, audits .. ; Together with the Visual Merchandising Team, ensure that the standards on store image are kept according to Company guidelines and coordinate the proper training for sales staff; Ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels; Ensure proper attire, grooming and behavior in line with the brand’s guidelines; Grant the compliance to operational procedures provided by the Group; Lead by example & Team spirit: lead and motivate the team to accomplish and maximize the sales target and retail KPIs; Oversee the boutique maintenance; Handle all customer’s enquiries and complaints; Customer Relations Management: Treat the customer according to brand’s standards: ensure that each customer receives outstanding standards, solid product knowledge and all other components of Customer Service; Act as a Brand Ambassador when representing the Brand at meetings, events (local & international) and other work-related functions; Build strong customer relationships and enhance loyalty; Acquire a relevant customer database, convert into sales transaction and retain the customer for future transactions; Monitor & execute the Boutique CRM program; Team Management: Performs all necessary supervisory functions to effectively and efficiently manage the personnel assigned: Hire, lead and act as advisor to boutique team regarding projects, tasks and operations; Define and communicate missions and objectives of all team members, clearly establishing priorities and reasonable deadlines; Formulate sales team’s goals and objectives, motivate staff and reinforce engagement; Motivate the boutique team around the strategy and vision of the Maison; Fosters a cooperative and harmonious working climate to maximize employees morale and productivity; Act as a coach and assist the colleagues in operations, sales and training; Job profile: Bachelor graduated with at least 10 years retail experience, preferably in luxury jewelry/watchmaking sector; Qualification/ training in watches & jewelry, knowledge of diamond grading and design; Preferably with qualification in gemology; Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment; MS Office experience required (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Fluency in English and French is mandatory; the knowledge of another language is a plus (Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Italian); Personal Skills: Managerial skills and proactive approach; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Ability to delegate tasks and follow up to ensure execution; People friendly and comfortable dealing with VIP clients; Excellent representation skills; Focused, target oriented and organized; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Similar Jobs Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Stock Administrator Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati

jobs.title: Intern Team Performance Training (100%)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132397 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Team Performance Training Department we are looking for an INTERN TEAM PERFORMANCE TRAINING (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 In this stimulating internship, you are working on HQ Team Performance Training projects while being in close contact with our international platforms, giving a global dimension to this position. The role is allocated within the Global Commercial Team and reports directly to the Global Head of Team Performance and Digital Training. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Ad-hoc analysis of global commercial KPIs. Preparation and analysis of sales data for market coaching, market visits and executive management presentations. Creation and further development of existing coaching and training tools, content, roadmaps, tracking, feedback coordination, etc. Support with creation of digital training content via our internal app and presentation content related to product, service and performance. Support virtual studio operation and creation of studio presentations. Organization and coordination of large HQ-trainings (approx. 2-3 trainings per internship). Support for the Team Performance Training Team with additional needs in administration, budgeting, reporting, new project management etc. HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. 
• Your profile should combine both quantitative (e.g., analytical thinking, number crunching, etc.) and qualitative (e.g., creative ideas, design affinity, etc.) skills: Currently enrolled or recently graduated from a bachelor's or master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality or similar. First experience in the field of Sales / Retail / Marketing / Finance / Consulting is a plus. Team player with strong analytical and project management skills. Independent, dedicated and highly motivated individual with a high affinity for our brand and strong enthusiasm for our products. Proactive and flexible mindset with a hands-on mentality. Very strong digital tool knowledge and at ease with different software solutions, especially Excel and PowerPoint (SAP knowledge is an asset). Fluent in English (excellent written and verbal communication) is a must and any other language is a plus. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs, including financial support for external childcare. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! Similar Jobs Intern Public Relations (100%) Save Schaffhausen, Switzerland IWC Intern Visual Merchandising (100%) Save Schaffhausen, Switzerland IWC Intern Social Media & Content (100%) Save Schaffhausen, Switzerland IWC

jobs.title: Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132495 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT Supply Chain is a key driver of Maisons’ overall performance. It must be agile to provide the best end-to-end product availability and ensure client satisfaction, anytime and anywhere. Group Supply Chain Solutions act as an internal consulting branch, supporting Maisons in their transformation ambitions. Our mission: foster Supply Chain transformation to strengthen Maisons’ competitive advantage. You will discover in Richemont a strong manufacturing ecosystem and work closely with the Maisons and the internal manufactures HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will promote analytics & reporting tools Create, improve and maintain the upstream analytics and reporting tools Support Maison’s to leverage the analytics and reporting tools implemented Contribute to ongoing projects Support the preparation and animation of workshops Run ad-hoc analysis to support ongoing projects and bring data-base insights to the team Formalize outputs of analysis/workshop to prepare steering comittees You will support the Upstream growth and structuring Co-design and build methodological kit of our best practices Build user guide for our in-house tools Create communication support to promote initiatives internally WHAT ARE THE EXCEPTIONAL SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR? Enrolled in the last year of a Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering Industrial Supply Chain experience/knowledge Good organization and communication skills Appetence for data-analytics combined with solid analytical skills Solid dashboard/visualization tool skills (PowerBI) SQL basics are a plus Fluent in English and French HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two thousand years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Geneva, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. The offices are close to local transport with direct access to the train station. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Supply Chain Knowledge Management Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Executive - UAE National Save Dubai, United Arab Emirates Van Cleef & Arpels Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury Project Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132493 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we believe in the power of dreams and the artistry of emotion. We are seeking a dedicated and elegant individual to join our Maison in Zurich as a Sales Associate. If you are passionate about exceptional service and the enchanting world of High Jewellery, we invite you to discover this unique opportunity. Do you match this profile? You are adaptable, an empathetic communicator, and an attentive listener, embodying the grace and care synonymous with our Maison. You possess a deep passion for the enchanting world of High Jewellery, the unique universe of Van Cleef & Arpels, and the exquisite artistry of craftsmanship. You are naturally at ease in a refined boutique environment, engaging with a diverse clientele during their boutique visits and high-profile events, both international and local, with discernment and warmth. You are seeking a collaborative and benevolent team environment where a shared passion for exceptional client care contributes to a truly harmonious atmosphere. You hold a university degree and speak fluent Swiss German, German, and English, and proficiency in a fourth language will be a strong advantage. You possess proven experience within luxury jewellery or watches Maisons, demonstrating an innate understanding of sophisticated service and elegance. A genuine appreciation for the world of high jewellery, luxury goods, and the unique savoir-faire that defines Van Cleef & Arpels. Interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to articulate the Maison's heritage and creations with elegance and conviction, allowing you to create a long lasting relationship with the clients. A natural ability to anticipate and exceed the expectations of a sophisticated clientele, delivering an unparalleled client experience. Proficient in using IT tools such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint and email. If so, we would love to get to know you! What do we expect from you? As a Sales Associate in our boutique, you are the voice of Van Cleef & Arpels for our clients, and you build and maintain strong relationships with them. You are an ambassador of the Maison, promoting its image both internally and externally. You demonstrate excellent commercial acumen and actively participate in the recruitment and development of new clients. You aim to offer a unique experience to our loyal clients. You convey the refinement, elegance, and innovation that inspire the Maison's creations. You leverage your passion for history and art, complemented by a breadth of general knowledge, to cultivate exceptional bonds with our most discerning clientele More than a job... an experience! Joining Van Cleef & Arpels means becoming part of a revered Maison where the growth and flourishing of our talents are paramount. You will embark on a comprehensive onboarding journey, offering a rich tapestry of training on our illustrious history, unparalleled savoir-faire, and iconic creations, complemented by continuous daily support within a benevolent and collaborative environment. We believe in recognizing exceptional talent and dedication. 
• We offer a competitive remuneration package that reflects the value we place on our team members and their contributions to the Maison's enduring legacy. Joining Van Cleef & Arpels also means becoming part of Richemont, a global leader in luxury, offering a world of opportunities to grow within prestigious Maisons, each renowned for its unique artistry and heritage. Apply online. If your profile is selected: You will be contacted by the Talent Acquisition team for an initial online interview. A boutique-based interview will follow to meet the management team. You will then meet the Retail Manager and HR Business Partner for the Swiss market. jobs.title: Intern Visual Merchandising (100%)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132467 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Visual Merchandising team at our headquarters in Schaffhausen, we are looking for an INTERN VISUAL MERCHANDISING (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: October 2026 As Intern for our Visual Merchandising Team, you will gain a fascinating insight into the world of IWC. You will be able to enhance your Project Management skills as part of a highly motivated and efficient team. During the internship, you will provide mainly administrative support in a creative environment and gain valuable insights into our work processes. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Project management for various topics related to our upcoming new Retail and Wholesale campaigns Project Management of customised displays Creation of basic and seasonal Visual Merchandising guidelines Maintenance support for our Visual Merchandising evaluation tool Yoobic Sourcing and ordering of decoration articles Creating orders of VM articles in SAP Organizing and following up on transportation orders General administrative team-support (ordering, invoicing, communication etc.) HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. Currently enrolled in or recently completed Bachelor or Master’s degree in Business / Marketing or equivalent studies Proficient use of Microsoft Office: Excel, Power Point, Word, SAP experience is a plus Experience in the field of visual merchandising is a plus Fluency in English is required, German is a plus Exact, insistent, dainty way of working with a strong eye for details combined with a feeling and affinity for luxury Hands-on mentality and service-oriented mindset WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs, including financial support for external childcare. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! jobs.title: Stock Administrator
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132535 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. We are looking for enthusiastic, passionate, dynamic people to join our new retail team in Geneva! Your 
• Responsibilities Inventory Management Responsible for stock replenishment and novelties Track stock levels, place purchase orders (POs), and coordinate with the store team and head office for stock replenishment and transfers Receive, inspect, and verify merchandise against orders, ensuring accuracy and quality standards. Report any discrepancies or damaged products to the Boutique Managers. Oversee stock levels, coordinate deliveries, and monitor inventory accuracy. Classify, tag, and organize stock in accordance with store procedures for easy accessibility and replenishment. Conduct and assist with monthly inventory counts, reconciling discrepancies and ensuring records are up-to-date. Manage the handover and follow-up of maintenance goods, ensuring proper documentation and tracking. Support daily system operations related to stock management as per policy Financial Operations Reconcile daily sales documents, invoices, and cashier operations, ensuring compliance with company standards. Maintain accurate records, handle correspondence, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Manage tax receipts and statements, including monthly tax control system operations. Oversee processes related to returns and replacements, ensuring accurate records and compliance. Store Operations Support Assist with budget tracking, expense management, and preparation of financial reports. Manage daily operations, including scheduling, maintenance, and vendor coordination. Prepare sales, inventory, and operational reports for management review. Work closely with the Boutique Manager and staff to ensure operational needs are met. Ensure that health and safety standards, as well as company guidelines, are followed Monitor and manage inventory of store supplies (e.g., visual merchandising materials, stationery, packaging, guest refreshments). Ensure timely ordering and replenishment. Assist with VM display adjustments, monthly display reports, and inventory of props. Maintain store operation manuals and ensure adherence to company processes and standards. Provide occasional support during sales activities. Ensure high housekeeping standards and vigilance regarding security measures in the store. Your 
• Profile 2-3 years of experience in retail in a similar position. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook). Strong organizational and time-management skills with a keen eye for detail. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work collaboratively in a team environment. Fluent in English and French, Italian is an advantage. Similar Jobs Boutique Manager Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati

jobs.title: Intern Social Media & Content (100%)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132527 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Social Media & Content Team we are looking for an INTERN SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 Join our team and become a key player in shaping our social media and content marketing campaigns. Reporting to the Team Lead, Social Media & Content, you will manage social media channels, develop engaging content, and collaborate with external and internal teams on innovative projects. This role also offers the opportunity to acquire an overview of the entire global brand marketing campaign scope, from orchestration to implementation. We are looking for someone with a passion for luxury, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach. If you are a detail-oriented team player with a keen eye for copy and design, we encourage you to apply! YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Social Media Write and design Instagram stories, providing art direction for these visual formats in collaboration with our inhouse creative team Prepare content briefs and coordinate the design process with the creative team Responsible for planning and scheduling daily social media posts across diverse platforms, optimizing the content calendar, and paid investment support in collaboration with the Social Media and Content Manager Coordinate social media assets for retailers Content Manage relationships with agencies and copywriters Develop new content projects and identify opportunities to leverage existing content in innovative ways Assist with the coordination of special IWC shoots and provide administrative support for photo and video shoots Collaborate with the Events, FOBs, PR, and Creative Center departments on content creation and project development Responsible for developing and collaborating with the Team Lead, Social Media & Content, on our major partnerships and racing topics Marketing campaigns Support the coordination and implementation of the social media campaigns Track campaign status, timelines, and implementation progress Assist in campaign orchestration Contribute to the development of post-campaign reports and performance summaries HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. Currently enrolled in or recently completed bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Marketing, and/or Communications Passionate about social media and content in an international luxury company Passionate about luxury and you have an aesthetic sensitivity Good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint are required Business fluent English skills are required Resilient, dynamic, and team player personality with a pro-active and curious attitude Curiosity towards consumer trends and needs, especially in the luxury environment Able to work in a fast-paced environment with clear, prompt, and concise reporting style graphic and design knowledge Detail-oriented and task-driven WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. jobs.title: Logistic Digital & Data Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132522 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? This internship will provide you with hands-on experience in logistics performance management, master data and digital transformation. You will be fully integrated in Richemont Internal Distribution Logistic Agility team to contribute to different projects and initiatives. Your key responsibilities will include: DATA & ANALYTICS Logistics Reporting Support: Assist in setting up and improving logistics dashboards, ensuring alignment with global KPIs and reporting guidelines. Continuous Improvement: Participate in logistics optimization projects and develop new methodologies to enhance performance measurement. Data Management Support: Use BI tools (Power BI, SAP, GCP, Looker) to analyze and visualize logistics performance data. DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION Process Analysis & Optimization: Map existing processes to identify inefficiencies, manual bottlenecks, and key opportunities for digitalization and automation. Solution Design & Implementation: Support the design, development, and deployment of logistic digital tools. Project Support: Contribute to ongoing digital transformation initiatives, supporting the implementation as well as helping with documentation. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are currently pursuing a Master’s/Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong interest in logistics, performance management, and data analysis or digital transformation, Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SAP, SQL and capable of structuring and managing databases. Proactive and autonomous, with a self-driven mindset and a can-do attitude. Detail-oriented and rigorous, able to synthesize and communicate complex analyses effectively. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data/processes and provide actionable recommendations. Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, to collaborate with various internal stakeholders. Fluent in French and English. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? At Richemont, we embrace a culture of performance and continuous improvement. We foster diversity, collaboration, and innovation, providing an engaging and dynamic environment to tackle tomorrow’s logistics challenges. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will contact you for an initial discussion. You will then have the opportunity to meet the team and gain insights into the role’s challenges and expectations. Ready to take on the challenge? Apply now! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Logistics Digital Transformation Manager Save Tokyo, Japan Richemont Supply Chain Knowledge Management Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Sustainability Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Chef de Projets
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132589 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Chef de Projets - CDM 2 ans Maximum Rattaché au Département Transformation, vous êtes au cœur de notre dynamique de progrès. Votre rôle est hautement transverse et vous êtes garant de la diffusion de la culture Lean à tous les niveaux. Votre leadership vous permet de piloter plusieurs projets transverses depuis la phase de diagnostic jusqu’à l’ancrage des améliorations. Vous identifiez les leviers permettant l’atteinte d’objectifs ambitieux et pilotez les plans d’actions ainsi que la formation des équipes COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? 
• Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de 3 piliers majeurs : Pilotage de Projets de Transformation & Optimisation des Flux Mener des diagnostics complets et analyser de manière pertinente nos processus industriels pour identifier les leviers de progrès prioritaires. Piloter des projets transverses de bout en bout : de la définition des plans d’actions à leur mise en œuvre sur le terrain (secteurs de production et services supports). Animation de la Communauté & Conduite du Changement Soutenir nos Entités Autonomes de Production (EAP) et nos services supports dans la réalisation de leurs plans de progrès. Animer activement la communauté de l'Excellence Opérationnelle au sein de la manufacture pour favoriser les synergies et le partage de bonnes pratiques. Data & Performance Exploiter le potentiel des nouvelles technologies pour moderniser nos approches Lean Développer des outils et applications d'aide au pilotage pour faciliter le quotidien des équipes. COMMENT RÉUSSIREZ-VOUS CHEZ NOUS ? Vous bénéficiez d’un diplôme d’Ingénieur généraliste / génie industriel, idéalement complété par une formation Lean management et autres méthodologies d'excellence opérationnelle (Six Sigma ou équivalent) Vous justifiez 3-5 ans d’expérience dans le pilotage de projets dans un secteur industriel Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l’industrie 4.0 et vous possédez une appétence forte pour le Lean Manufacturing, ses concepts, sa posture et son savoir-être Vous êtes orienté clients, résultats et focalisé sur l’impact des solutions proposées Vous avez un esprit entrepreneurial et d’excellentes capacités d’analyse Humble et rigoureux, vous faites preuve d’empathie et avez des facilités à communiquer à tout niveau Vous êtes reconnu pour votre diplomatie ainsi que votre capacité à fédérer QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. jobs.title: Ingénieur R&I Mécatronique/Electronique
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132611 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. QUELLE SERA VOTRE CONTRIBUTION ? En tant que membre du Stream Automation & Process Engineering de la direction Recherche & Innovation de Richemont, vous participez à l’industrialisation et pilotez la réalisation et le maintien en conditions opérationnelles de systèmes mécatroniques innovants. Dans le cadre de votre mission, vous contribuez à la mise en place de nouvelles technologies au sein des Maisons du Groupe. Votre impact sur l’organisation se mesurera au travers des missions spécifiques suivantes : Support au développement et à l’industrialisation En collaboration avec les équipes R&I, participer au développement et à l’industrialisation de systèmes mécatroniques et électroniques Développer et mettre en œuvre des plans de tests et de validation Réalisation des systèmes Récolter les commandes auprès des Maisons du Groupe Piloter la réalisation des systèmes et gérer les sous-traitants Gérer l'approvisionnement et garantir la disponibilité (obsolescence et stock) des composants Assurer la réception des équipements et en garantir la conformité Mettre en service les systèmes et former les utilisateurs Maintien en conditions opérationnelles Assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles des systèmes et supporter les équipes des Maisons en production Analyser les dysfonctionnements et proposer des solutions correctives Assurer la gestion documentaire QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE GROUPE ? Vous êtes au bénéfice d’une formation d’ingénieur·e HES en microtechnique ou électronique, ou jugé équivalent Vous démontrez de minimum 8 ans d’expérience professionnelle en milieu industriel Vous disposez d’une expérience reconnue dans le développement, l’industrialisation et la mise au point de systèmes mécatroniques à forte dominante électronique Vous êtes un bon communicateur et faite preuve d’une grande autonomie dans l’organisation de votre travail. Vous disposez dans l’idéal des compétences techniques suivantes : Expertise en systèmes mécatroniques et électroniques Pratique avancée des méthodes d’industrialisation, de fabrication et de test de systèmes mécatroniques Excellentes connaissances en mécanique, moyens de fabrication et d’assemblage et électronique Expérience en utilisation d’outils PLM Des connaissances en logiciel sont un atout Notions de sécurité machines A l’aise en français et en anglais, vous appréciez de partager vos connaissances au sein d’équipes collaboratives et constructives. Désireux·euse de contribuer aux défis techniques de l’industrie du luxe, vous êtes orienté résultats, curieux·euse et entreprenant. Votre sens de l’organisation et vos capacités de communication seront également des clés essentielles de votre succès. VOTRE EXPÉRIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS 1. Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous contacterons dès que possible pour un premier appel de présentation avec le Manager. 2. En cas d’intérêt, il vous sera demandé de préparer un business case et de le présenter lors d'une réunion sur site, en présence du Manager de Stream et d’un représentant des RH. A cette occasion, nous approfondirons nos échanges et évaluerons l’adéquation entre nos attentes respectives. 
• Nous offrons un contrat de durée maximale de 12 mois, renouvelable. APPRENEZ-EN PLUS SUR RICHEMONT ET SES MAISONS https://www.linkedin.com/company/richemont/ https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtcz344eqsWvggwOnq-yljg #RICHEMONT #REVEALTHEEXCEPTIONNAL WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Ingénieur R&I Systèmes mécatroniques et logiciels Save Buttes, Switzerland Richemont Spécialiste Analyses Matériaux Save Glovelier, Switzerland Richemont Ingénieur R&I Firmware & Architecture Ultra Low Power (H/F) Save Buttes, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Responsable Logistique VDJ
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132609 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Au sein de notre Manufacture du Brassus (VD) vous orchestrer et optimiser l'ensemble des flux physiques et informationnels liés à la production, depuis l'approvisionnement jusqu'à l'expédition, afin de garantir une adhérence optimale au plan de production. Pour ce faire, vous coordonner de manière directe les activités de planification/ ordonnancement (4 personnes) et de manière indirecte, les réceptions /expéditions (9 personnes) tout en menant une démarche globale d’optimisation des flux et process. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER PILOTAGE OPERATIONNEL & COORDINATION TRANSVERSE Participer activement au processus S&OP afin d’assurer l’adéquation charge/capacité et anticiper les besoins de production. Piloter les analyses de performance et les plans d’actions associés grâce à des KPI pertinents et orientés résultats. Garantir le suivi et la maîtrise des opérations afin d’atteindre les objectifs de qualité, coûts et délais. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes transverses (Développement Mouvements, Achats, Qualité, Production) afin de garantir une coordination efficace et une communication proactive. Coordonner les lancements de production en lien avec le Plan Directeur de Production. Superviser les activités du Warehouse central et assurer une gestion fluide des flux logistiques. OPTIMISATION DES FLUX & EXCELLENCE OPERATIONNELLE Accompagner la transformation des flux et des processus pour renforcer l’agilité et la robustesse de l’organisation. Identifier, prioriser et piloter les initiatives d’amélioration continue en cohérence avec les enjeux stratégiques du site. Optimiser les flux logistiques et industriels en appliquant les principes Lean Manufacturing (Kanban, CONWIP, flux tirés, standardisation). Structurer les processus et renforcer les standards opérationnels afin d’améliorer durablement la performance. Développer une culture orientée résolution de problèmes, innovation et efficacité opérationnelle. MANAGEMENT D’EQUIPE & DEVELOPPEMENT DES COMPETENCES Manager et développer une équipe performante : planifier et organiser le travail, soutenir et responsabiliser les collaborateurs pour atteindre les résultats escomptés. Promouvoir le développement des compétences : gérer le plan de relève, favoriser la polyvalence, identifier les besoins en formation et encourager l’évolution professionnelle de chaque membre de l’équipe. LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER Issu(e) d’une formation d'ingénieur (ou titre équivalent) en Supply Chain, Gestion de Production Industrielle ou Logistique, vous bénéficiez d’une expérience managériale de 10 années dans un environnement industriel. Vous êtes capable de vous positionnez à la fois sous un angle stratégique et opérationnel pour supporter au mieux l’activité de production du site. Vous êtes en parfaite maîtrise de SAP, des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel mais aussi Power BI. Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. Optimiser les flux logistiques et industriels en appliquant les principes Lean Manufacturing (Kanban, CONWIP, flux tirés, standardisation). Structurer les processus et renforcer les standards opérationnels afin d’améliorer durablement la performance. Développer une culture orientée résolution de problèmes, innovation et efficacité opérationnelle. MANAGEMENT D’EQUIPE & DEVELOPPEMENT DES COMPETENCES Manager et développer une équipe performante : planifier et organiser le travail, soutenir et responsabiliser les collaborateurs pour atteindre les résultats escomptés. Promouvoir le développement des compétences : gérer le plan de relève, favoriser la polyvalence, identifier les besoins en formation et encourager l’évolution professionnelle de chaque membre de l’équipe. LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER Issu(e) d’une formation d'ingénieur (ou titre équivalent) en Supply Chain, Gestion de Production Industrielle ou Logistique, vous bénéficiez d’une expérience managériale de 10 années dans un environnement industriel. Vous êtes capable de vous positionnez à la fois sous un angle stratégique et opérationnel pour supporter au mieux l’activité de production du site. Vous êtes en parfaite maîtrise de SAP, des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel mais aussi Power BI. Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. jobs.title: Stagiaire Projets IA RH
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132628 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Au cours de votre stage, vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Conception et Déploiement d'Agents RH Travailler en collaboration avec les experts métiers RH pour comprendre les besoins et les problématiques, afin d'identifier les processus pouvant être optimisés par des Agents RH. Tester, itérer et accompagner la mise en production de ces Agents sur les plateformes internes, en assurant la documentation technique et fonctionnelle. Monitorer l'adoption et l'efficacité des Agents déployés, et proposer des améliorations continues. Développement d'un Tuteur IA pour notre plateforme digitale de formation : Participer activement à la conception et au développement d'un Tuteur basé sur l'Intelligence Artificielle, intégré à notre plateforme digitale de formation. Offrir une expérience utilisateur personnalisée et interactive, en identifiant les besoins spécifiques des collaborateurs pour l'apprentissage et le développement des compétences. Collaborer avec les équipes de formation et les experts techniques pour définir les fonctionnalités, le contenu et l'interface du Tuteur IA, et contribuer à son intégration technique et son déploiement. jobs.title: Technicien Méthodes Qualité
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132682 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Contrat à durée maximale de 24 mois CONTEXTE Afin d’accompagner le développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un Technicien Méthodes Qualité en charge de définir, mettre au point et valider les processus de contrôle applicables au sein des différents secteurs de notre Manufacture dans le respect des standards établis. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Acteur de l’équipe d’industrialisation composée des Méthodes de production, des Méthodes industrielles, du Bureau d’Etudes et des Méthodes Qualité, vous serez chargé de garantir la capabilité de l’ensemble des processus de contrôle. Pour ce faire, vous participez à la co-construction des plans, vous définissez et concevez les posages, les gammes et les programmes de contrôle. Vous partagez l’ensemble de ces éléments à l’équipe transverse et les validez afin d’obtenir un consensus sur le processus de contrôle. Vous accompagnez les équipes terrain (interne et externe) lors du déploiement des processus de contrôle et les formez à l’utilisation des moyens proposés. Vous proposez, validez et appliquez les standards de contrôle dans l’objectif de digitaliser et automatiser les livrables de contrôle et ceux de l’équipe d’industrialisation. Vous mettez à jour les données système et assurez le reporting de votre activité et des KPI du département. Vous apportez votre support aux équipes terrain dans le suivi de la vie série des composants pour anticiper les difficultés, proposez les actions ou modifications nécessaires, assurez le suivi des modifications mises en œuvre. Vous participez aux différents projets d’amélioration continue de l’entreprise impactant les Méthodes Qualité ainsi qu’aux analyses de non-conformité et à la co-construction de solutions nouvelles. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Titulaire d’un diplôme de Technicien avec une spécialisation dans la métrologie ou dans l’usinage, vous maitrisez la programmation de commandes numériques. Vous justifiez de solides connaissances dans le domaine de la lecture de plans (cotation ISO GPS). La connaissance du secteur de l’horlogerie, de même que la maitrise de Calypso-Zeiss, Keyence type LM Séries, ou de CREO sont des plus. Vous êtes rigoureux, orienté résultats, aimez travailler sur le terrain et avez un fort esprit de service. Vous êtes reconnu pour votre ouverture d’esprit ainsi que votre capacité à travailler en équipe tout en faisant preuve d’autonomie dans vos responsabilités. Vous êtes à l’écoute, pragmatique et proactif. Vous maitrisez le pack office (Windchill un plus). QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence. VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS : Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Méthode Qualité ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé. Contrat à durée maximale de 24 mois CONTEXTE Afin d’accompagner le développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un Technicien Méthodes Qualité en charge de définir, mettre au point et valider les processus de contrôle applicables au sein des différents secteurs de notre Manufacture dans le respect des standards établis. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Acteur de l’équipe d’industrialisation composée des Méthodes de production, des Méthodes industrielles, du Bureau d’Etudes et des Méthodes Qualité, vous serez chargé de garantir la capabilité de l’ensemble des processus de contrôle. Pour ce faire, vous participez à la co-construction des plans, vous définissez et concevez les posages, les gammes et les programmes de contrôle. Vous partagez l’ensemble de ces éléments à l’équipe transverse et les validez afin d’obtenir un consensus sur le processus de contrôle. Vous accompagnez les équipes terrain (interne et externe) lors du déploiement des processus de contrôle et les formez à l’utilisation des moyens proposés. Vous proposez, validez et appliquez les standards de contrôle dans l’objectif de digitaliser et automatiser les livrables de contrôle et ceux de l’équipe d’industrialisation. Vous mettez à jour les données système et assurez le reporting de votre activité et des KPI du département. Vous apportez votre support aux équipes terrain dans le suivi de la vie série des composants pour anticiper les difficultés, proposez les actions ou modifications nécessaires, assurez le suivi des modifications mises en œuvre. Vous participez aux différents projets d’amélioration continue de l’entreprise impactant les Méthodes Qualité ainsi qu’aux analyses de non-conformité et à la co-construction de solutions nouvelles. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Titulaire d’un diplôme de Technicien avec une spécialisation dans la métrologie ou dans l’usinage, vous maitrisez la programmation de commandes numériques. Vous justifiez de solides connaissances dans le domaine de la lecture de plans (cotation ISO GPS). La connaissance du secteur de l’horlogerie, de même que la maitrise de Calypso-Zeiss, Keyence type LM Séries, ou de CREO sont des plus. Vous êtes rigoureux, orienté résultats, aimez travailler sur le terrain et avez un fort esprit de service. Vous êtes reconnu pour votre ouverture d’esprit ainsi que votre capacité à travailler en équipe tout en faisant preuve d’autonomie dans vos responsabilités. Vous êtes à l’écoute, pragmatique et proactif. Vous maitrisez le pack office (Windchill un plus). QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence. VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS : Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Méthode Qualité ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé. jobs.title: Spécialiste Analyses Matériaux
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132699 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Les Ateliers de Métallurgie Suisse est une entreprise qui détient la patente d’Essayeur-fondeur et qui approvisionne les marchés horlogers et joaillers en produits semi-finis. NOUS RECHERCHONS Intégré(e) au sein du département Laboratoire Matériaux sur le site de AMS à Glovelier, vous conduirez des analyses dans le domaine des matériaux et gérerez divers projets. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Vous aurez en charge de piloter des projets de Développement et d’Innovation. Vous assurerez également la gestion intégrale de mandats d’analyses. Pour ce faire, vous devrez réaliser des analyses avancées. Vous serez reconnu comme expert dans votre domaine de compétences et devrez assurez un rôle de conseiller et de formateur. Vous devrez également développer et maintenir les équipements du Laboratoire tout en contribuant au fonctionnement, au développement et à la promotion de ce dernier. LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Issu(e) d’une formation Ingénieur en Sciences des Matériaux (EPF, Grandes Ecoles…), vous justifiez idéalement d’une première expérience dans le domaine de la métallurgie. Vous faites également preuve d’aisance dans les techniques expérimentales et vous appréciez améliorer les méthodes d’analyse. Votre connaissance et votre maîtrise du MEB (EDX, EBSD,…) et d’autres techniques avancées (DRX, Réflectivité…) seraient un sérieux atout. Rigoureux (se), méthodique et doté(e) d’un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, vous savez vous adapter aux différentes situations. Une maitrise des outils Excel ou autre outil facilitateur pour la gestion et/ou l’automatisation du traitement de données (Matlab, Python…) serait un plus. Dans le cadre de la gestion du parc d’équipements du laboratoire, vous serez amené à prendre en charge la maintenance et le contact avec les fournisseurs. Votre proactivité, votre grand sens de l’organisation, votre autonomie et sens de l’initiative ainsi que votre capacité d’adaptation seront des atouts pour mener à bien cette mission. Un bon esprit d’équipe et d’entraide est indispensable. Doté (e) d’une grande flexibilité et enclin à apporter votre expérience et support dans des projets transverses en collaboration avec des départements/laboratoires internes, vous appréciez les challenges d’équipe. Rigoureux (se), méthodique et doté(e) d’un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, vous savez vous adapter aux différentes situations. Une maitrise des outils Excel ou autre outil facilitateur pour la gestion et/ou l’automatisation du traitement de données (Matlab, Python…) serait un plus. Dans le cadre de la gestion du parc d’équipements du laboratoire, vous serez amené à prendre en charge la maintenance et le contact avec les fournisseurs. Votre proactivité, votre grand sens de l’organisation, votre autonomie et sens de l’initiative ainsi que votre capacité d’adaptation seront des atouts pour mener à bien cette mission. Un bon esprit d’équipe et d’entraide est indispensable. Doté (e) d’une grande flexibilité et enclin à apporter votre expérience et support dans des projets transverses en collaboration avec des départements/laboratoires internes, vous appréciez les challenges d’équipe. jobs.description: Reference code: JR132728 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur (ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une première expérience dans un poste similaire, idéalement acquise dans un environnement industriel. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des concepts, outils et méthodologies de l’Excellence Opérationnelle et du Lean manufacturing (VSM, DMAIC, Kaizen, 8D etc). Vous êtes pragmatique et savez écouter les besoins des équipes métiers. Vous êtes curieux, organisé et rigoureux. Vous aimez travailler de manière autonome et proactive. Vous maîtrisez les bases de la gestion de projet (planification, reporting, animation d’ateliers). Vos qualités de communication, votre esprit d’équipe et votre bon relationnel vous permettent de collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés, de favoriser l’adhésion aux changements. QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement innovant et positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Notre équipe RH analysera ensuite votre entretien. Si votre candidature est retenue, vous recevrez, quelques jours avant le 1er octobre 2026, une invitation pour notre Talents Day, notre journée de recrutement 100% digitale. À cette occasion, une offre de stage spécifiquement adaptée à votre profil vous sera également proposée. #WeAreCartier#TalentDay Cette journée immersive au cœur de l'univers Cartier vous permettra de rencontrer un(e) référent(e) RH et un(e) manager.
