descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR133558 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is seeking a highly skilled Group International Mobility Manager to support the execution of our international mobility practice. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and compliant relocation of employees across international borders, enhancing operational excellence and the overall experience for our mobile population and Group entities. You will manage all aspects of the international assignment lifecycle, adhering to company policies, legal requirements, and best practices. Reporting to the Head of Global Mobility, you will support the translation of strategic framework designs into seamless, day-to-day processes, reinforcing governance and consistency, and expertly managing international assignments with a strong focus on policy application and compliance. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position International Mobility as a strong operational and business-enabling capability for HR, combining delivery excellence, stakeholder partnership, mobility governance, and continuous improvement. In Particular, You will: Own the end-to-end delivery of international mobility assignments (e.g., long-term assignments, short-term assignments), ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely execution. Provide expert guidance and support on international mobility policies, benefits, and processes to assignees, their families, and business stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for our business stakeholders throughout the entire assignment lifecycle. Interpret Group International Mobility policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent and fair application across the organization. Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulations related to international mobility. Coordinate and manage relationships with external vendors, including tax advisors. Monitor vendor performance and ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met, guaranteeing efficient and effective service delivery. Stay abreast of global immigration, tax, and social security regulations relevant to international assignments. Collaborate closely with legal and tax departments to ensure compliance and proactively mitigate risks. Partner with HR Business Partners and Compensation & Benefits teams to prepare comprehensive assignment cost projections and compensation packages. Provide comprehensive support to assignees and their families, addressing queries and concerns related to relocation, cultural adjustment, and integration, fostering a positive employee experience. Maintain accurate records and data within international mobility management systems. Prepare insightful reports and analyses on assignment costs, trends, and compliance metrics to support decision-making. Act as a subject matter expert, providing expert advice, training, and support to HR Teams and business on international mobility topics. Contribute to and support the continuous improvement, optimization, simplification, and automation of international mobility processes, tools, and guidelines to enhance scalability, efficiency and sustainable delivery across teams. Leverage project management methodologies and Agile principles to drive the delivery of mobility enhancements, ensuring alignment between business priorities, capacity, and execution. Promote effective communication and understanding of international mobility policies and processes. Actively participate in and contribute to international mobility projects and strategic initiatives. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, International Relations, Law, or a related field (Master's a plus). 5+ years of solid experience in international mobility management, with a strong understanding of various assignment types, policies, and compliance (tax, social security, immigration) in a complex international environment. A solid grasp of international mobility trends, best practices, and regulatory frameworks. In-depth expertise in international tax implications for assignees and the company, including tax equalization, hypothetical tax, gross-up, social security agreements, and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions. Understanding employment law, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and other legal aspects relevant to international assignments Excellent client focus, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and cultures. Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and proven adaptability in a dynamic environment. Demonstrated capability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with international assignments. Proven project management skills, able to lead or significantly contribute to international mobility projects. Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, Workday) and international mobility management software, as well as Microsoft Office Suite. Fluent in English; French is an asset. Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value collegiality, courage, curiosity, empathy, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. jobs.title: Retail Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133589 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join, for one year, our International Retail Solutions department, as Retail Operations Coordinator. The Retail Operations Coordinator, based in Couvet, supports the STAGE Manager in overseeing daily operations at STAGE, Cartier’s experiential space and mock-up boutique dedicated to retail experimentation and training. In this multi-task role, the coordinator helps ensure smooth running of activities such as testing, training, role play, filming, and product demonstrations, while securing all necessary resources and requirements. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? RETAIL OPERATIONS & AREA MAINTENANCE Run monthly inventories, deliver reports, and process SAP receipts/returns. Manage quarterly stock updates (returns and novelty orders). Oversee STAGE equipment supply and coordinate shipping (packaging, customs). Maintain hardware/software for IT testing and manage broadcasting systems. Align VM with global campaigns and coordinate general maintenance. Partner with the Retail Solutions Team to test and integrate prototypes. Visit boutiques regularly to identify and suggest operational improvements. Exchange best practices and network with global Retail Ops peers. VISITS PREPARATION & MANAGEMENT Prepare the STAGE area for visitors alongside the Hospitality & Event coordinator. Operate the STAGE broadcasting system. Lead engaging group tours (FR/EN) focusing on retail innovation and boutique operations. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You have 5 years of experience in Retail Operations or Retail Logistics. Youa are proficient in Office 365 and digital tools; knowledge of SAP (stock management) is a strong plus. You are highly organized, proactive, autonomous, agile, and a strong communicator. You are flexible and at ease in a fast-changing environment. You are fluent in English and French On-site presence required (maximum 20% remote work, depending on operational needs). WHAT DO WE OFFER? We create a positive environment and highlight your personal and team performances. We’re fully transparent and share with you: Maison strategies, key information, needs of others Corporate Departments. We constantly educate you with: Cartier’s savoir-faire, competitive landscape, industry news, client experience best practices. jobs.title: Chef de projet Qualité F/H
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133565 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON En tant que support technique privilégié, vous accompagnerez l'ensemble de nos équipes qualité et veillerez à l'Assurance Qualité de nos développements produits. Venez contribuer activement à une culture d'amélioration continue et à l'atteinte de nos objectifs qualité les plus ambitieux. Vous serez un acteur clé dans la naissance de chaque nouveau calibre. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER En rejoignant notre équipe, vous serez un pilier essentiel de notre démarche qualité, avec des responsabilités variées et stimulantes. Pilotage de Projets Qualité Stratégiques : Vous coordonnez des projets qualité transverses pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits et processus. Vous assurez la gestion complète du déploiement et du suivi de ces projets (respect des plannings, animation des comités de suivi bimensuels avec la direction, soutien et relance des équipes). Vous initiez et contribuez à la démarche d’amélioration continue axés sur les problématiques dimensionnelles et esthétiques. Vous contribuez activement aux projets d'innovation de la Maison. Support Opérationnel et Amélioration Continue : Vous assurez un support technique quotidien à l'ensemble du département Qualité. Vous êtes acteur dans la définition, le déploiement et l’exploitation des outils Qualité multi-services au sein de l’entreprise. Vous assurez le back-up du rôle de technicien qualité, incluant le pilotage des QRQC Vous initiez et suivez la résolution de problèmes liés aux rebuts, en garantissant la rigueur des démarches (arbres des causes, respect des étapes, etc.). Développement et Suivi des Indicateurs de Performance : Vous participez activement à la définition, la mise en place et la maintenance des KPI pour tous les départements Qualité. Vous contribuez à la création d'indicateurs Qualité pertinents en exploitant des données issues de SAP, PowerBI, SharePoint et Excel. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les différents métiers pour harmoniser les pratiques et définir de nouvelles règles communes. LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER : La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation Technicienne ES, CFC ou d'un titre jugé équivalent dans le domaine de la micromécanique, de la mécanique générale ou de l'horlogerie. Une formation complémentaire en contrôle qualité, métrologie ou assurance qualité serait un réel atout. Une expérience significative en tant que Chef de projet qualité, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture horlogère, ou dans un environnement industriel exigent lier aux lignes de production, à la conduite de projet et à l'amélioration continue. Votre maîtrise des aspects techniques de la fabrication industrielle et votre excellente connaissance des instruments de mesure. Votre expertise sur les démarches d’amélioration continue et de résolution de problèmes (5 Pourquoi, 8D, PDCA, AMDEC...). Votre maitrise de SAP et des outils bureautiques (traitement de texte, tableur avancé avec graphes et tableaux croisés dynamiques, outils de présentation). Votre excellent sens de l'écoute et de la communication, vous maîtrisez l'art de piloter et d'animer des séances de travail de manière efficace. Votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse sont reconnus. Vous faites preuve de méthodes et de pertinence. Votre capacité à anticiper, faire preuve de réactivité, d'adaptabilité et d'une capacité à vous remettre en question. Votre pédagogie, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et avez un sens aigu du service. Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. Venez contribuer activement à une culture d'amélioration continue et à l'atteinte de nos objectifs qualité les plus ambitieux. Vous serez un acteur clé dans la naissance de chaque nouveau calibre. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER En rejoignant notre équipe, vous serez un pilier essentiel de notre démarche qualité, avec des responsabilités variées et stimulantes. Pilotage de Projets Qualité Stratégiques : Vous coordonnez des projets qualité transverses pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits et processus. Vous assurez la gestion complète du déploiement et du suivi de ces projets (respect des plannings, animation des comités de suivi bimensuels avec la direction, soutien et relance des équipes). Vous initiez et contribuez à la démarche d’amélioration continue axés sur les problématiques dimensionnelles et esthétiques. Vous contribuez activement aux projets d'innovation de la Maison. Support Opérationnel et Amélioration Continue : Vous assurez un support technique quotidien à l'ensemble du département Qualité. Vous êtes acteur dans la définition, le déploiement et l’exploitation des outils Qualité multi-services au sein de l’entreprise. Vous assurez le back-up du rôle de technicien qualité, incluant le pilotage des QRQC Vous initiez et suivez la résolution de problèmes liés aux rebuts, en garantissant la rigueur des démarches (arbres des causes, respect des étapes, etc.). Vous contribuez à la création d'indicateurs Qualité pertinents en exploitant des données issues de SAP, PowerBI, SharePoint et Excel. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les différents métiers pour harmoniser les pratiques et définir de nouvelles règles communes. LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER : La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation Technicienne ES, CFC ou d'un titre jugé équivalent dans le domaine de la micromécanique, de la mécanique générale ou de l'horlogerie. Une formation complémentaire en contrôle qualité, métrologie ou assurance qualité serait un réel atout. Une expérience significative en tant que Chef de projet qualité, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture horlogère, ou dans un environnement industriel exigent lier aux lignes de production, à la conduite de projet et à l'amélioration continue. Votre maîtrise des aspects techniques de la fabrication industrielle et votre excellente connaissance des instruments de mesure. Votre expertise sur les démarches d’amélioration continue et de résolution de problèmes (5 Pourquoi, 8D, PDCA, AMDEC...). Votre maitrise de SAP et des outils bureautiques (traitement de texte, tableur avancé avec graphes et tableaux croisés dynamiques, outils de présentation). Votre excellent sens de l'écoute et de la communication, vous maîtrisez l'art de piloter et d'animer des séances de travail de manière efficace. Votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse sont reconnus. Vous faites preuve de méthodes et de pertinence. Votre capacité à anticiper, faire preuve de réactivité, d'adaptabilité et d'une capacité à vous remettre en question. Votre pédagogie, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et avez un sens aigu du service. Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. jobs.title: Team Leader Pick & Pack
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133646 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXTE Richemont International Distribution recrute pour son centre de distribution de Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Pick & Pack. Vous aurez la responsabilité de garantir la bonne exécution et la conformité des opérations Pick & Pack selon les réglementations et directives ainsi que le management opérationnel de l’équipe. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? 
• Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Grâce à votre relationnel constructif et votre orientation résultats, vous savez créer les bonnes conditions pour emmener votre équipe d’opérateurs logistiques à atteindre les objectifs de qualité, coût, délai et sécurité. Vous les soutenez au quotidien dans la réalisation de leur activité par le coaching et l’animation de la performance. Par votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité d’analyse, vous veillez, avec vos collègues, à développer continuellement la performance de votre secteur. De plus, nous pouvons compter sur vous pour faire l’extra mile qui satisfera nos clients à 100%. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS REUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure (HEG, Université ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion d’équipe et de projet. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances dans le domaine de la logistique et de la Supply Chain. Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au cœur des activités, dans un environnement dynamique et challengeant et êtes disposé à travailler en équipe d’après-midi (13h-22h). Rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous avez une bonne résistance au stress et êtes capable de comprendre/anticiper les problèmes et de visionner un impact ou une solution. Excellent communicateur, vous assurez une communication efficiente avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes et vous vous démarquez par votre force de proposition et votre capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. La maîtrise de SAP ainsi que de POWER BI (ou autre outil d’analyse de datas) sont un atout. Vous avez une parfaite maîtrise du français (C2) ainsi qu’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de communiquer aisément (min. B2). QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’équipe RH vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique. Ensuite, un entretien avec le manager direct sera planifié. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Team Leader Process Operations Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont GL Accountant Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Référent technique polissage Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Cartier Manufacture

jobs.title: Apprenti Opérateur en horlogerie AFP
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133614 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Missions Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 2 ans pour obtenir votre Attestation Fédéral de formation Professionelle d’Opérateur·trice en horlogerie. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de l’horlogerie. Au cours de cette formation, vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur une diversité de modèles de montres, tout en acquérant des savoir-faire essentiels en matière d'efficacité et de productivité. Responsabilités Maîtriser l'assemblage de mouvements mécaniques, automatiques et à quartz Réaliser l'habillage des montres : pose des cadrans et des aiguilles, emboîtage et fixation du bracelet Acquérir les bases techniques du polissage S'initier aux fondamentaux de la micromécanique Participer à divers stages pratiques au sein de nos ateliers et auprès d'entreprises partenaires. CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Connaissances suffisantes du français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle Aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques Intérêt et curiosité et motivation pour les produits horlogers et les mécanismes de précision Dextérité manuelle, autonomie et rigueur Faculté de concentration, patience et raisonnement logique Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous serons ravis d'étudier votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera examiné par nos équipes de recrutement et de formation. Si votre profil retient notre attention, vous serez convié·e à une journée découverte et/ou recrutement axée sur divers tests pratiques et théoriques. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. jobs.title: Team Leader Process Operations
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133644 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXTE Richemont International Distribution recrute pour son centre de distribution de Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Process Operations. Vous aurez la responsabilité de manager et coordonner l’équipe de Spécialiste Process Opérations, qui ont pour mission de faciliter l’identification des dérives de processus et résoudre les problèmes opérationnels. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? 
• Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Grâce à votre relationnel constructif et votre orientation résultats, vous savez créer les bonnes conditions pour emmener votre équipe de Spécialiste Proces à atteindre les objectifs de qualité, coût, délai et sécurité. Vous les soutenez au quotidien dans la réalisation de leur activité par le coaching et l’animation de la performance. Par votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité d’analyse, vous veillez, avec vos collègues, à développer continuellement la performance de votre secteur. De plus, nous pouvons compter sur vous pour faire l’extra mile qui satisfera nos clients à 100%. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS REUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure (HEG, Université ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion d’équipe, de projet et Management de la Qualité. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances dans le domaine de la logistique et de la Supply Chain. Rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous avez une bonne résistance au stress et êtes capable de comprendre/anticiper les problèmes et de visionner un impact ou une solution. Excellent communicateur, vous assurez une communication efficiente avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes et vous vous démarquez par votre force de proposition et votre capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. La maîtrise de SAP et d’outils d’analyses de datas sont un atout. Vous avez une parfaite maîtrise du français (C2) ainsi qu’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de communiquer aisément (min. B2). QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’équipe RH vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique. Ensuite, un entretien avec le manager direct sera planifié. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Team Leader Pick & Pack Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont GL Accountant Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Ingénieur Amélioration continue Save Geneva, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Responsable de Ligne Produit F/H
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133762 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Au sein du département Manufacturing, la/le Responsable de Ligne Produit est en charge des process industriels (ébauche, terminaison, garnissage) intervenants dans la production d’une même famille de produit. Dans ce cadre, elle/ il assure un pilotage rigoureux et quotidien de son périmètre en termes de planification, management des ressources, pilotage des actions correctives, productivité dans le respect simultané des critères qualité, quantité, coûts, délais, sécurité. Elle/ il accompagne à la fois l’industrialisation de nouveaux développements produits et la production en vie série sur sa ligne et participe activement au processus d'amélioration continue avec l’appui des supports Qualité, Méthode et des Référents Techniques dédiés par process. La/ le Responsable de ligne produit anime une équipe pluridisciplinaire (de 20 à 35 personnes) représentant plusieurs métiers de l’environnement machines et manuel. VOTRE ROLE A JOUER ? - Pilotage opérationnel Mettre en œuvre le programme de production tout en veillant au respect quotidien des critères qualité, quantité, coûts, délais, sécurité, Superviser l'ordonnancement et l'approvisionnement de son périmètre, Coordonner, répartir la charge de travail et veiller au bon équilibrage de la ligne, Gérer l'activité et le reporting (indicateurs de suivi de production), Réaliser l'avancement de la production dans l’ERP, Assurer la prise en compte de la maintenance corrective et curative de son périmètre. Assurer la disponibilité du matériel dans son périmètre. - Coordination de la résolution de problème selon le standard Maison Collaborer avec les différents départements concernés pour la fiabilité et l'amélioration des méthodes de travail et des outils, Détecter, signaler et gérer les problèmes techniques propres à son périmètre, Collaborer avec les différents interlocuteurs terrain (Qualité, Méthodes, Référents Techniques, Collaborateurs, homologues...) pour proposer des solutions permettant la résolution de problème en lien avec son domaine de compétences. - Pilotage de l’équipe Animer et coordonner l’activité de l'équipe journalièrement (séance perf, séances amélioration continue...), Planifier et organiser le travail, soutenir, responsabiliser et motiver l'équipe pour atteindre les résultats, Piloter les effectifs (absences, congés, remplacements, besoins en recrutement, roulements) et les moyens nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs, Procéder aux entretiens d'évaluation (performance, compétences) Favoriser le développement des compétences de l'équipe sous sa responsabilité, Définir et déployer le plan de polyvalence nécessaire à la continuité d’activité, Evaluer les besoins en formation (enrichir les postes de travail, synergies et la mutualisation des ressources), Recruter de nouveaux collaborateurs en collaboration avec les RH, Etre garant du respect et de l'application des règlements (SST, règlements internes). LES QUALITES POUR EXCELLER ? Vous êtes issu(e) d'un cursus d'étude d'ingénieur ou du domaine de la gestion de production. Vous bénéficiez d'une solide expertise dans le pilotage de production industrielle, idéalement dans un contexte multisite soumis à des échéances courtes. Vous avez évolué dans un secteur d'activité animé par des impératifs de haute exigence qualité et d'excellence. Vous êtes en capacité de mobiliser, donner du sens et accompagner des équipes pour répondre collectivement aux objectifs de production quotidiens. Vous appréciez d'évoluer dans un environnement challengeant, requérant une agilité permanente. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. jobs.title: Compliance intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133753 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Join our dynamic Group Legal team at Richemont and gain invaluable experience in a vibrant multinational environment. As a compliance intern, you will support the central compliance function by contributing to a broad range of compliance projects and initiatives. This includes exposure to areas such as regulatory risk management, regulatory watch and legal developments monitoring, competition law, anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions compliance, anti-corruption, and conflicts of interest. The role provides hands-on experience with compliance processes and activities, offering valuable insight into the operation of a global compliance program. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The key responsibilities for this role will be:
• Assist in reviewing and enhancing AML, sanctions, and anti-corruption compliance procedures and controls.
• Conduct research on competition (antitrust) law topics and contribute to the preparation of guidelines, FAQs, and training materials.
• Contribute to the deployment of various compliance disclosure and approval tools.
• Contribute to the development and roll-out of compliance training programs and awareness campaigns.
• Assist in the preparation of compliance reports, dashboards, and presentations for management.
• Participate in in and contribute to departmental meetings and projects.
• Work collaboratively in a multicultural and multilingual environment. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Currently enrolled in a full-time law degree or Bar Exam preparation.
• Previous experience as an intern in an international company or law firm is preferable
• Demonstrate robust legal skills with excellent drafting and communication capabilities.
• Personality is key: positive energy, with a strong team spirit, capable of adapting to an international and fast-paced setting
• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in French and/or German is a strong plus
• An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory.
• You can commit to a 6-months internship with a starting date on or before 1 December 2026 WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.
• We value collegiality, humility, and integrity.
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage.
• We care for the world we live in YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Mergers & Acquisitions Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Group Talent Communities Management Director, reporting to the HQ Group Talent Director, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Richemont's talent landscape. Your mission will be to define, develop, and animate our internal talent communities across all Maisons, Regions, and Functions. You will foster the growth, engagement, and retention of our diverse talents, ensuring alignment with our commercial ambitions, particularly within our retail business globally. This involves driving the strategic vision for talent management and ensuring consistent development paths across the Group. Your key responsibilities will include: Strategic planning: Define and implement the long-term vision and strategic axes for Talent Communities Management, including specific strategies for creative, marketing/merchandising, and retail talent management. You will contribute to overall capability development through targeted community animation and specific learning paths, while integrating external insights on market trends and innovations. Talent Management 360: You will ensure a global 360-degree view of talent management within communities, ensuring optimal talent pools are secured in close collaboration with HRDs and Talent Acquisition. This includes defining clear and consistent career paths, ensuring consistency in job catalogues and titles working closely with Group Rewards. You will also lead continuous management of assessment and career development tools, including Talent management process in Workday. Talent Assessment & Community Engagement: You will collaborate closely with Learning & Development teams to support the continuous upskilling and employability of our talents and structure the implementation of consistent and progressive career paths. You will also drive the development of robust succession plans and centralize internal mobility strategies. You will also build & monitor specific talent pools across Maisons’ HQ and Regions, with strong succession plans for senior management roles across all Maisons supporting their career development plans. You will contribute to the design and manage the operational implementation of international development programs for international retail sales experts and high-potential talents in the Group. Stakeholder Collaboration: You will animate the HR Talent Management community across Maisons and Divisions, organizing regular meetings on common priorities and projects and involve HR and partner departments in sharing the strategic vision and operational components. You will align with Maison HRDs, Regional teams, L&D, and Commercial/Marketing Directors to ensure a cohesive approach to talent management, actively participating in global talent meetings. Project Management & Communication: You will lead and ensure the proper execution of strategic talent projects, defining and monitoring key performance indicators for talent communities, and managing annual assessments for retail boutique managers and sales communities. Furthermore, you will develop and implement impactful communication strategies for key talent initiatives, ensuring effective communication of our talent strategy across all levels and to top management. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are a passionate and experienced HR professional with: A proven experience within the luxury fashion and accessories industry, with a strong understanding of: creative/design and studio functions as well as marketing, communication organizations with Maisons and regions. A minimum of 15-20 years of international HR and/or people management experience, ideally within a large, complex international group. Significant expertise in Talent Management, Talent Assessment, Development, and HR Business Partnering, with exposure to talent community management. A proven track record in project management, familiar with the Retail, Marketing, and/or Merchandising environments, ideally within the luxury sector. Knowledge and Experience in F&A is a strong plus. Mastery of HR development processes such as mobility management, succession planning, and learning & development. Strong analytical and synthesis skills, highly organized, rigorous, and adept at data analysis. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a natural ability to build and nurture internal networks. An open, creative, positive, results-oriented, and flexible mindset, thriving in matrix organizations and complex, fast-paced, multicultural environments. Strong stakeholder management and digital savviness. Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in other languages, particularly Chinese or Japanese, French and Italian are a plus. Strong analytical and numeric skills. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group HR Reporting Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Sales & Purchasing Advisor
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133772 Since Watchfinder & Co. was first founded in 2002, it has grown to become the premier resource from which to buy and sell premium pre-owned watches. With thousands of watches available from more than 50 brands, including Rolex, Omega, IWC and more, plus boutiques across the UK and a manufacturer certified service centre, Watchfinder has established itself as the top pre-owned watch specialist. YOUR MISSION: The Sales & Purchasing Advisor is responsible for delivering stellar client experience and for achieving his/her personal sales targets as well as those of the boutique. He/She needs to act as an ambassador of Watchfinder at all times with client satisfaction being his/her utmost goals. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of a permanent position thereafter starting on October 1st, 2026 approx. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?
• Hosting clients and other stakeholders with the ability to provide personalised customer experience.
• Find ever new and creative means to exceed client’s expectations.
• Introduce clients to the different services that we offer, including the part-exchange service, maintaining a high level of experience to the clients.
• Developing personal clientele through effective use of the selling skills, proactive client outreach (CRM).
• Know WF’s history, services/products and partnerships as well as the benefits of purchasing a timepiece through Watchfinder.
• Act as a brand ambassador inside and outside the boutique.
• Maintain the boutique according to the global operating standards.
• Be part of a boutique team and support the overall organisation of the boutique with a strong team approach.
• Lead the appraisal process of timepieces that involve a part-exchange. Ensuring that all the necessary processes are followed accurately for the end user to make an assumption. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Applicants with a background in sales or hospitality preferred.
• Strong team player mindset.
• Excellent communicator with ability to develop strong networks.
• Curious and resourceful. Able to work independently on the sales process.
• Result-orientated and driven.
• Accountable and reliable.
• Able to handle a large diversity of tasks in a timely manner, very organised and disci-plined.
• Perfect understanding of client satisfaction and luxury experience and strong sense for etiquette and human behaviour.
• Able to approach individually to respective client.
• Open & Outgoing personality.
• Demonstrate eagerness and enthusiasm to learn and grow.
• Creative, curious and versatile with good interpersonal competences and empathetic.
• Has perfect manners and can maintain a conversation elegantly. Still wondering why, you should apply ? You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Send your application online. If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful. jobs.title: Manager Mécanique et Outillage
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133802 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. VOTRE MISSION : Vous veillez à garantir la livraison des outillages dans les délais, avec la qualité attendue et dans le respect des coûts. Vous optimisez les processus, les ressources et la gestion de la charge/capacité, tout en maintenant une agilité suffisante pour répondre aux urgences de production. Vous reportez en direct au Responsable Méthodes & Industrialisation. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? Votre rôle s'articulera autour des missions suivantes : Gestion de l'équipe > Animer, motiver et encadrer une équipe d’une vingtaine de collaborateurs dont 3 leaders. > Favoriser le développement des compétences et la polyvalence. > Créer un environnement de travail positif, basé sur la communication et l’esprit d’équipe. > Définir les objectifs individuels et collectifs et développer les compétences des équipes. > Gérer la relation avec les fournisseurs externes et piloter les commandes d'outillages sous-traités. Gestion de la production > Garantir la livraison des outillages dans les délais et selon les normes de qualité. > Planifier et optimiser l’adéquation charge/capacité du service. > Communiquer de manière proactive sur les risques, dérives et plans d’actions. Stratégie et développement > Être force de proposition pour l’amélioration des conceptions d’outillages, des procédés de fabrication, des équipements et de l’organisation du département. > Étudier et définir l’intégration de nouveaux équipements et technologies de production en assurant leur pertinence et leur rentabilité. > Assurer une veille technologique afin d’anticiper les évolutions du secteur. > Promouvoir une culture de performance, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue. Indicateurs de performance > Suivi du taux de service. > Suivi charge/capacité. > Suivi du taux de retour et des motifs. > Suivi des coûts (sous-traitance, consommables et coûts outillages). COMMENT RÉUSSIREZ-VOUS CHEZ NOUS ? Vous disposez des compétences ci-dessous : Compétences techniques Vous disposez d’excellentes connaissances : > En conception d'outillage : modélisation 3D, élaboration de plans 2D et définition d'outillages de précision. > En procédés de fabrication :usinage conventionnel et CNC et assemblage. Une connaissance dans les étampes automatiques et progressives serait un atout apprécié. Informatique / Langues > Connaissance des outils informatiques et de la suite Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams). > Windchill, CREO, etc. nécessaires à l’environnement de travail digitalisé. Savoir-être Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership et votre bonne communication. Agile, entreprenant, méthodique et rigoureux, vous êtes orienté qualité et client, avec un excellent sens relationnel. Vous savez gérer les priorités et les urgences et êtes orienté résultats. jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133785 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. FINANCIAL CONTROLLER PLAN-LES-OUATES CDI FOR THOSE WHO WELCOME CONNECTION Join a highly connected community where individual expertise and shared experience combine across disciplines to spark fresh ideas and keep us moving forwards. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE As a pivotal member of the Vacheron Constantin Finance Central Team, you will be instrumental in executing our ambitious Finance Roadmap along our Finance Strategy that is built upon four core pillars: Value Creation, Business Partnering, Continuous Improvement, and People Development. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133793 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. ROLE PURPOSE The Government Affairs Sr Manager, CH, US will support the execution of the Group’s global government affairs strategy, with responsibility for driving impact and building influence in priority international markets. The role is accountable for government affairs engagement in Switzerland and the United States, aligned with business priorities and in coordination with the other Group Government Affairs team members. The engagement will evolve over time to include international markets outside the EU. Fully integrated within Group Corporate Affairs and working in close alignment with Group Central Functions, Group Regions, and Maisons, the position will ensure consistent, high-impact engagement with policymakers and stakeholders in support of the Group’s and its Maisons’ business priorities and long-term reputation. The Government Affairs Sr Manager, CH, US will report to the Group Government Affairs and Industry Relations Director and will be part of the Group Government Affairs team. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Strategy Execution & Market Prioritisation Lead the implementation of the Group’s global government affairs strategy across international markets, with clear prioritisation of key geographies. Translate global policy priorities (e.g. ESG, trade, data, tax, product regulation) into targeted, market-specific engagement plans. Lead execution in assigned priority markets, ensuring strict alignment with Group positions and messaging. Stakeholder Engagement & Influence Lead the Group’s government affairs activities in Switzerland and the United States, developing and executing tailored engagement strategies. Build and maintain senior-level relationships with policymakers, regulators, and key stakeholders. Support senior leadership engagement with government stakeholders, particularly in Switzerland, given its role as the Group’s headquarters location and a key strategic stakeholder environment. Ensure coordinated and consistent engagement across Maisons. Position the Group as a trusted and credible partner in policy discussions impacting the luxury sector. Develop and execute annual stakeholder engagement plans with clear objectives, milestones and measurable outcomes aligned with Group priorities. Policy Monitoring & Advocacy Monitor and assess relevant policy, legislative and regulatory developments across assigned markets. Develop and implement advocacy strategies in priority international markets. Monitor and assess geopolitical, trade and economic policy developments impacting the Group's international operations and support advocacy strategies to protect market access and business continuity Ensure alignment with Group positions before external engagement. Coordinate with trade associations and external partners’ advocacy strategies in line with the Group Government Affairs strategy and Maisons needs. Represent the Group within relevant trade associations and industry platforms in selected markets, ensuring alignment with Group priorities and maximizing responsible influence through collective advocacy, collaborating with committee representatives to bring additional expertise when relevant. Internal Coordination and Integration Work closely with Group Central Functions, including Legal, Sustainability, Communications, Operations, Marketing, Human Resources, Finance, relevant Maisons, and Group Government Affairs Senior Manager, Europe to align on policy priorities and engagement plans. Ensure consistency of messaging and positioning across markets. Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on political and regulatory developments. Contribute to building a cohesive government affairs operating model, building a coordinated and effective approach across the Group. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS Fluent in English and French. German highly desirable. Strong communication skills, verbal and writing. Exceptional interpersonal and relationship management skills, ability to manage by influence. High energy and a positive attitude, with a pleasant and open personality. Sound judgment and strong intellect. Ability to be a trusted advisor for senior executive members. Proactiveness and flexibility, displaying a can-do attitude. Strong understanding of policy-making processes in key markets, particularly United States and Switzerland, with exposure to international environments. Must have a strong network in Switzerland and a well-established one in the United States. Demonstrated ability to build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders. Highly organised and results-oriented, ability to work under pressure. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Humanities, Political Science, International Relations, Law, Economics, or Social Sciences, Master’s degree a plus. 10-15 years’ experience in government affairs, public policy, or related fields. Background spanning corporate, public sector, or consultancy environments. Strong expertise across government relations/public affairs and communications disciplines, including crisis/issues communications. Experience in consumer-facing industries or regulated industries is an advantage. Comfortable with ambiguity and power dynamics. Strong business acumen. Each of the areas of responsibility will involve a variety of different challenges requiring the person to be both flexible and adaptable whilst demonstrating gravitas in their dealings with internal and external stakeholders. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Senior Workplace & Facilities Manager, SEAO Save Singapore, Singapore Richemont China Affairs & Strategy Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Head of Group Insurance Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR133812 Roger Dubuis has been at the forefront of contemporary Haute Horlogerie since 1995. Its expressive timepieces house the finest watchmaking mechanisms, created in its integrated manufacture in Geneva and certified by the Poinçon de Genève. The quest for excellence, the long search for the right gesture, the development of unique skills are all constants of Roger Dubuis. We are crafting a vibrant work environment where collaboration is celebrated, audacity is encouraged, and pleasure in what we do creates truly enriching experiences. We are looking for unique, audacious and creative individuals who are eager to take part in the Roger Dubuis adventure. * Store Design & Planning * Define the planning for the different projects (renovations, special projects) Coordinate accordingly the actions between markets, internal architects, external agencies and creative director for project execution, from conceptualization to opening Manage budgets and timelines for store design projects, ensuring adherence to deadlines and costs Ensure the maintenance and updating of design standards and guidelines for all existing boutiques * Visual Merchandising Strategy & Execution * Define and implement Maison’s global visual merchandising strategy, including window displays, in-store exhibitions, product presentation, and special displays Create and distribute detailed visual merchandising guidelines for all boutiques, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution Provide design implementation recommendations to the markets for fairs, boutiques and events animations Develop creative concepts for seasonal campaigns, new collection launches, and special events, in collaboration with Marketing and Communication teams Track and coordinate shipments between suppliers, HQ and markets (annual order) Train and support sales teams and retail managers in the application of visual merchandising guidelines Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of visual merchandising strategies, proposing improvements and adaptations * Team & Stakeholder Management * Lead and motivate internal (commercial and marketing team, internal architects) and external key stakeholders (suppliers and agencies) Drive, coordinate and support the markets * Budget * Providing the proper reporting and monitoring of the annual budget QUALIFICATIONS At least 7-10 years of progressive experience at international level in Store Design and/or Visual Merchandising roles, preferably within the luxury sector Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet strict deadlines An architecture background is a nice to have A sense of aesthetic, with a deep understanding of luxury and design Strong communication and interpersonal skills Excellent command of French and English (written and spoken) Willingness to travel frequently nationally and internationally for site visits and project supervision. Similar Jobs Boutique Director Save Singapore, Singapore Roger Dubuis Geneva Lounge Manager Save Geneva, Switzerland Roger Dubuis Commercial Dev & Ops Manager Save Taipei, Taiwan, China Roger Dubuis

Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. For our Public Relations division we are looking for an Intern Public Relations Start: November 2026 Duration: 6 months Join IWC's Global PR Team at our headquarters for an exciting internship experience. You will gain hands-on experience in planning and executing various PR projects, directly contributing to the brand's awareness. Success in this role demands strong organizational capabilities, keen attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced professional environment. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Active assistance in the planning, organizing, and implementation of various PR projects PR analytics including monitoring and evaluation of campaigns and other PR activities Editing and responding to national and international media inquiries in coordination with IWC markets Support with PR reports and PowerPoint presentations Support of the PR Team in the daily business and with administrative tasks (SAP, invoicing, press page upload, best of press coverage, watch shipments, logistics, event coordination etc.) HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. Bachelor's or Master's degree in communications, journalism, or comparable studies Strong analytical mindset with interest in data analysis and interpretation. A key responsibility of this role involves conducting thorough PR analysis and generating insightful reports based on quantitative findings Independent, proactive, structured, and organized Strong team player with excellent communication skills Fluency in English. German and French are an advantage Excellent MS Office skills First professional experience in PR is an advantage (e.g., luxury goods, fashion, advertising**/ agency**, etc.) WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs, including financial support for external childcare. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! jobs.title: Marketing Activations Project Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133883 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. YOUR MISSION Acting as a key cross-functional lead, the Project Manager owns the development of these campaigns from strategic briefing through creative development and production to Go-To-Market, equipping regions and markets with compelling 360° campaign strategies, assets and toolboxes for impactful local activation. The role also supports key Maison initiatives, including exhibitions, events and boutique openings, through the development of dedicated marketing and communication assets. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? ACTIVATIONS & INTEGRATED MARKETING CAMPAIGNS Lead the development of global 360° ambassador and seasonal celebration campaigns, from strategic framing and creative briefing through campaign development, asset production and the delivery of comprehensive Go-To-Market toolboxes. Build strategic and creative briefs and orchestrate cross-functional teams, partnering with Product, Creative, Digital, Media, CRM, PR, Events, Client Experience, Retail, VM and Trade Marketing to develop cohesive campaign strategies across relevant touchpoints. Drive creative development and asset production with internal teams, agencies and external partners, ensuring the highest standards of brand expression while managing timelines, budgets and deliverables. Develop dedicated marketing and communication assets for key Maison initiatives, including exhibitions, events and boutique openings, in close collaboration with the relevant project owners and internal teams. Drive Go-To-Market readiness and support regional and local activation, anticipating project needs and risks, delivering clear activation frameworks and toolboxes, and providing markets with the strategic guidance and assets required for relevant and consistent local implementation. Measure campaign effectiveness and drive continuous improvement, consolidating market results and feedback, identifying key learnings and translating them into actionable recommendations for future campaigns. SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT Manage the global social media editorial calendar and campaign activations, coordinating content planning and local adaptations with key markets, including China, Japan and Korea. Oversee day-to-day social media operations, including content publishing through Sprinklr and Community Management, ensuring consistency, responsiveness and a high-quality client experience across channels. Monitor social media performance and KPIs, consolidating results and identifying actionable insights to continuously optimise content and engagement. WHAT ABOUT YOU? 3–5 years of experience in integrated marketing, brand communications or campaign management Proven experience leading the development of complex, multi-channel campaigns, involving multiple stakeholders, markets and external partners. Strong project management skills, ownership and accountability Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative production, content, digital and social media ecosystems. Ability to influence, challenge and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct hierarchical authority. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel. Strong knowledge of global and local social media platforms; experience with Sprinklr is an asset. Fluent in English and French, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. E-BUSINESS INTERN – 6 MONTHS INTERNSHIP – GENEVA Have you ever wondered what is like to be part of one of the finest watchmaking Maison? A unique experience is waiting for you in Jaeger-LeCoultre, we are looking for our next super Interns! How long, when and with whom? According to your affinity, you will join our departments for: 6 MONTHS INTERNSHIPS starting in OCTOBER in GENEVA, SWITZERLAND. Our Retail teams are looking forward to welcoming you. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT ? Ebusiness and activations Own and lead weekly ebusiness report; propose improvements, liaise with Group to make necessary changes Lead monthly digital cockpit for ebusiness with insights on why KPIs are evolving from one way or another with main takeaways Develop monthly report for digital cockpit on how customers are exposed to pre/post purchase services (chat, customer care, etc.), events, masterclasses, exhibitions, reasons to shop in their online journey in partnership with Webmaster Manage incidents and requests from markets while optimizing processes to lower volumes in collaboration with Ebusiness Manager and Ecommerce Product Manager Benchmark online experience from competitors and similar industries; analyze flow on our own flagship and propose new ways to improve experience back by data Develop report on how visitors are interacting with CRC online; deep dive on the impact on calls / emails / chat from traffic Build and implement checkout monitoring and onsite search optimization processes Benchmark experience and conversion enablers from competition and other industries (boxing and gifting, enhanced PDPs, CLPs, etc.) Local team support Provide comprehensive e-business support and guidance to local markets, ensuring operational excellence and strategic alignment Develop, enhance, and maintain local reporting and dashboarding tools, tailoring them to specific market needs and providing actionable insights Conduct in-depth analysis and research to inform and advance our omnichannel ambitions, identifying opportunities and recommending strategic approaches Collaborate with various stakeholders to gather requirements, implement solutions, and ensure the successful execution of e-business projects Provide first-level technical assistance and support for e-business operations at the local level Change management and housekeeping Across internal and external stakeholders, ignite an agile, positive, client focused and solution-oriented mindset; foster collaboration (360 meetings, etc.) Embody and provoke omnichannel vision while protecting the ECOM business Ensure data science folder on common is structured and up to date WHAT ABOUT YOU ? You are looking for an internship as part of your studies (Master) You have a good understanding of project management (timelines, etc.) You are eager to ignite a positive and solution-oriented mindset to serve our clients You are known for your curiosity, enterprising spirit, meticulousness, tendency to challenge the status quo, autonomous mindset, and ownership spirit You are fluency in French and English You have experience in analytics and tools such as Google Analytics, Data Studio, Looker and SAP BI as well as Microsoft Office Suite What you can expect from us? All of our interns have a key role in our day-to-day business success. Moreover, the close collaboration with an engaged and dedicated team is there to support you to succeed in this challenging and exciting role. During your time with us, you will get familiar with our know-how and gain practical insights into different business areas. Best of all, you will grow in a stimulating environment with excellent working conditions and attractive benefits! If you are the unique talent we are looking for, apply by May 1st 2026! The chosen candidates will be invited to participate to our Speed Recruitment Day on May 22nd, 2026 in Geneva. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133972 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. NOUS RECHERCHONS Vous serez chargé de définir et déployer les moyens pour effectuer les contrôles qualité à tous les stades de la fabrication et de l’élaboration du produit (horlogerie et joaillerie). VOS RESPONSABILITÉS Définir une stratégie de contrôle selon les spécificités du produit : Rédiger des gammes de contrôle Mettre en place les outils de mesures les plus adaptés aux contrôles de nouveaux produits : Participer aux réunions de développement produit Valider les premières séries avec la production Contrôler les pièces de soumission pour les clients Rédiger les rapports de soumission Analyser les processus de fabrication (capabilité) Participer aux résolutions de problème : Être le référent technique d’un point de vue métrologie Réaliser des mesures Analyser les suivis MSP Observer et analyser les résultats des contrôles effectués lors de la production : Études CMC / R&R et diverses analyses pour valider la pertinence des contrôles Capitaliser les informations pour jobs.title: Field Services Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133984 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: Reporting to the IT Proximity Team Leader and representing the Group IT department, the Field Services Intern is an active supporting member of the Field Services and Support (FSS) team. This internship is designed to offer hands-on professional development, assisting the team in delivering effective remote and physical IT support across the FSS perimeter. Under the close mentorship of the team, the intern will help deliver a high-quality, customer-centric service to business users, helping them engage with available technology. In this role, the intern will collaborate closely with Service Desk Analysts and Field Services Engineers, gaining valuable exposure to end-user support in a complex, prestigious international environment. The proposed start date is set for October 15th, 2026. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? 1. Project Management Help the team implement ongoing IT projects and deployment activities. Execute specific operational tasks assigned by the project team or mentors. Learn to manage tasks within structured timelines and deliver contributions on time. Assist in identifying potential risks or issues and report them promptly to senior team members. Proactively share observations and suggestions to improve project processes or user experiences. 2. Service Management Follow, understand, and learn to promote the established Group IT standards and compliance guidelines. Participate in staging, configuring, deploying, and administering basic hardware and software components under supervision. Assist in the proactive monitoring of local IT infrastructure and services under FSS supervision. Ensure proper operational follow-up of issues and assist in structured escalations to the relevant Group IT support teams. Help deliver excellent and effective support to business users through available communication channels. Assist in explaining and promoting available self-service technologies and tools to end-users to encourage adoption. Maintain a flexible, supportive mindset while learning and working within the FSS team's rotational support model. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Basic knowledge of operating systems (Windows, macOS), office suites, and standard hardware/device setups. A strong customer-oriented mindset, excellent communication skills, and a helpful, proactive attitude. Fluency in French. Professional level of English is a strong advantage. Enthusiastic to learn, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and a team player. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Accounting Intern Save Singapore, Singapore Richemont IT Co-op Trainee Save Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Richemont China Affairs & Strategy Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR134028 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Spécialiste métier (H/F) « Je cherche avant tout une personne sur qui je peux compter : experte dans son métier, généreuse dans la transmission de son savoir-faire et guidée par une conviction essentielle : la technique est au service de l’esthétique. » Annabelle CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Mission Au sein de notre secteur Bracelet Acier, vous évoluerez en tant que spécialiste métier du domaine du polissage dans un environnement stimulant et riche en apprentissage. Votre curiosité et votre esprit orienté vers la recherche de solutions participeront à faire rimer savoir-faire, qualité et performance. Responsabilités
• Vous serez le référent technique polissage au sein de l'atelier bracelet acier et apporterez soutien et formation aux polisseurs, tout en favorisant un bon climat de travail.
• Vous participerez activement à la production de l’atelier, participerez à l’organisation du travail et contribuerez à la performance de l'atelier par le suivi du planning, la répartition de la charge journalière et le suivi des rendements.
• Vous serez le garant de la qualité, de la résolution de problèmes techniques sur le terrain, et vous participerez à l'amélioration continue en garantissant la bonne application des processus.
• Vous apporterez un soutien au Responsable Secteur en relayant les informations techniques, en accompagnant l'équipe dans l'atteinte des résultats par une attitude positive et motivante et en étant force de proposition. CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS
• Votre expérience confirmée en polissage vous permet d’être le répondant technique du secteur.
• Vous êtes reconnu pour votre aisance relationnelle, votre capacité d’écoute et de communication.
• Votre capacité à fédérer vous permet d’accompagner une équipe d’environ 12 personnes en soutien du responsable.
• Dynamique, proactif et orienté solutions et résultats, votre bonne gestion des priorités vous permet de résister au stress.
• On reconnaît en vous une personne ouverte d’esprit, autonome et capable de se remettre en question.
• A l’aise avec les outils informatiques, vous utilisez facilement les outils digitaux de l’entreprise (Pack Office, Teams, Shizen.) VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison. Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez la Responsable secteur ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.
